news_mentions.headline: AFC West training camp 2026 preview: Top storylines for Broncos, Chargers, Chiefs, Raiders
news_mentions.description: As we hurtle toward the 2026 NFL season, Bobby Kownack breaks down the top AFC West training camp storylines to monitor for the Denver Broncos, Kansas City Chiefs, Las Vegas Raiders and Los Angeles Chargers.
news_mentions.body_text: with 2026 training camps just around the corner it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams bobby kownack has the lowdown on the key position battles and top storylines to monitor for the denver broncos kansas city chiefs las vegas raiders and los angeles chargers catch up on each afc west team s offseason developments and 2026 outlook below denver broncos kansas city chiefs las vegas raiders los angeles chargers three key storylines 1 nix s health receiving corps bo nix should be full go for training camp after suffering a broken ankle in last season s divisional round win but every step in the process bears watching when someone this important to a franchise is returning from injury once nix is out there eyes will also be glued to his pass catching group denver gifted its qb with a second no 1 wideout by trading for jaylen waddle to pair with courtland sutton and camp should provide the first hints as to whether the broncos will employ them as a 1a 1b combo or settle into a more defined pecking order plus can anyone from a proven supporting cast of troy franklin marvin mims and pat bryant emerge as the clear third option 2 denver has a new play caller reaching the doorstep of the super bowl didn t prevent sean payton from enacting sizable changes to the offensive staff he fired offensive coordinator joe lombardi two days after denver s afc title game loss and bumped davis webb up to replace him a month later payton publicly transferred play calling duties to the 31 year old former quarterback it s been a meteoric rise for webb who entered the coaching ranks as payton s qbs coach in 2023 webb has been learning under payton since then so nothing will be unrecognizable but nix still will need to get used to a new voice in his helmet any improvement for a 14th ranked scoring offense on a team that already won 14 games last season would be massive in the afc race 3 broncos are largely running it back roster wise the 2026 broncos are the personification of if it ain t broke don t fix it they took the big swing for waddle but barely signed any outside free agents denver instead focused on retaining talent losing defensive lineman john franklin myers and releasing linebacker dre greenlaw but basically keeping the band together even in the draft the club didn t make a pick until the third round apart from working waddle into the mix with webb now calling the shots the broncos can hit the ground running while many other contenders must start off with finding chemistry that s huge considering how unfriendly the first month and a half of denver s schedule appears at chiefs vs jaguars vs rams at 49ers at chargers and vs seahawks back to top three key storylines 1 when will mahomes be fully healthy patrick mahomes said during the offseason program that he s in a good spot in his acl lcl recovery and hopes to play in week 1 while andy reid told reporters the quarterback should be able to do some things at the start of training camp so how much will mahomes take on when the chiefs report and how quickly will he ramp up activity those questions don t have answers at the moment the chiefs hopes of returning to contention in 2026 and beyond rely heavily on the two time most valuable player so they ll be smart with him justin fields now on his fourth team in as many years could be one of the league s most intensely scrutinized backups as mahomes return timeline takes shape 2 kansas city s cb room begins anew again the chiefs have a habit of maximizing young cornerbacks talent and moving on before the bill comes due most recently they traded two time all pro trent mcduffie and let jaylen watson walk in free agency with both cover men going to the rams kansas city will call on 2025 third rounder nohl williams and mansoor delane this year s no 6 overall pick to fill the void fourth round rookie jadon canady should also be in competition for playing time with free agent signees kader kohou and l 39 jarius sneed the latter of whom returns to kansas city a couple of years after the team traded him to tennessee defensive coordinator steve spagnuolo s track record which includes three straight top six defenses in points allowed suggests things will work out just fine 3 bieniemy s back kansas city s offensive coordinator position has been devalued for years overshadowed by the prowess of patrick mahomes and andy reid perhaps it shouldn t have been during eric bieniemy s five years as the team s oc from 2018 through 2022 the chiefs never finished worse than sixth in the league in points or yards twice tallied the most points and three times amassed the most yards in the last three years without bieniemy the chiefs have ranked at average 17th in scoring and 15th in yardage there were obviously other factors in the decline such as tyreek hill exiting in a trade and travis kelce aging out of his prime but bieniemy returning still bodes well back to top three key storylines 1 mendoza s first camp the future of the raiders now rests on no 1 pick fernando mendoza s shoulders even if he isn t destined to start right away new head coach klint kubiak has communicated that his ideal scenario is to avoid putting a rookie under center in week 1 and by signing veteran kirk cousins las vegas essentially ensured mendoza s starting debut will come via choice rather than need still mendoza is coming off a perfect 16 0 season in which he took home the heisman trophy and led indiana to a national championship he s going to show up for the competition and all the buzz at raiders camp will revolve around him when he does 2 who steps up at wr las vegas has some starry names on offense quarterback fernando mendoza running back ashton jeanty and tight end brock bowers at wide receiver though there s work to do tre tucker was easily the team s most trustworthy wideout last year but he doesn t really profile as a wr1 jack bech and dont 39 e thornton 2025 second and fourth round picks respectively are looking to rebound from underwhelming rookie seasons free agent addition jalen nailor has a chance to show staying power in a larger role after flashing promise with 858 yards and 10 tds on 57 catches over the past two years with the vikings those are likely las vegas top four in some order but there s still a lot to shake out during the preseason 3 crosby s defense 2 0 in the four days between the raiders agreeing to send maxx crosby to the ravens and baltimore backing out of the trade las vegas spent a whole lot of dough rebuilding its defense for what was supposed to be the post crosby era now thanks to the blockbuster deal falling apart crosby is very much a part of the present the five time pro bowler returned to possibly the most talented unit the raiders have had during his career the linebacking corps has been rebuilt with nakobe dean and quay walker taron johnson brings more legitimacy to the cornerback room and kwity paye is set to line up on the edge opposite crosby reason for excitement in sin city extends far beyond the team s top picked qb back to top three key storylines 1 mcdaniel effect it was time for a change after the chargers scored 15 combined points in their last two wild card exits jim harbaugh fired offensive coordinator greg roman a longtime collaborator and replaced him with mike mcdaniel to hopefully supercharge the offense as the former dolphins coach did in his first couple years with miami mcdaniel s arrival as a quarterback whisperer is good news for justin herbert who already plays at a pro bowl level but the impact of his high octane system should be felt everywhere from the promising tight end trio of oronde gadsden david njoku and charlie kolar to omarion hampton in the backfield 2 fingers crossed for l a s o line los angeles offensive line should be a strength of the team in 2026 after disaster struck last season left tackle rashawn slater suffered a season ending patellar tendon tear in august while right tackle joe alt played just six games before requiring season ending ankle surgery herbert took a career high 54 sacks behind a patchwork offensive line leading the league with 268 pressures taken and a 43 3 pressure rate slater and alt are back but they ll also be joined on the line by free agent signings tyler biadasz and cole strange as well as second round rookie jake slaughter assuming the group stays healthy herbert should be well protected first though the bolts blockers have to jell together as a unit in august 3 chargers hope they have an edge rushing duo to build around the offseason didn t bring any sweeping changes for the chargers defense dalvin tomlinson 32 was their most notable signing to bulk up the interior and they lost a few pass rushers odafe oweh and da 39 shawn hand but largely maintained the status quo los angeles did however spend a first round pick on akheem mesidor the acc sack leader in 2025 with 12 5 there s enough pass rushing depth that mesidor won t have to take on too much too soon more importantly he has some stellar mentors in tuli tuipulotu who was sixth in the nfl last season with 13 sacks and nine time pro bowler khalil mack the hope is for a seamless transition from mack to mesidor alongside tuipulotu as the leaders of the l a edge rush back to top

news_mentions.headline: Arizona Cardinals training camp 2025 preview: Key dates, notable additions, biggest storylines
news_mentions.description: With the start of NFL training camps just around the corner, Grant Gordon provides a refresher on the Arizona Cardinals' roster changes, position battles and notable subplots.
news_mentions.body_text: with 2025 nfl training camps just around the corner it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams grant gordon has the lowdown on position battles key players and notable subplots across the nfc west catch up on the arizona cardinals offseason developments and 2025 outlook below training camp dates information players report july 22 rookies and veterans location state farm stadium glendale ariz fan information notable roster changes preseason schedule week 1 vs kansas city chiefs 8 p m et on saturday aug 9 week 2 at denver broncos 7 p m et on saturday aug 16 week 3 vs las vegas raiders 4 30 p m et on saturday aug 23 2025 schedule note arizona plays san francisco and seattle in back to back weeks twice weeks 3 4 weeks 10 11 but doesn t play los angeles the reigning nfc west champion until week 14 and then again in week 18 nfl research what you need to know 1 beneficiaries of two first round draft picks in 2024 the cardinals were left wanting much more from marvin harrison and darius robinson in total harrison s 62 receptions for 885 yards and eight touchdowns as a rookie are pretty solid but many thought the no 4 overall selection would be a superstar out of the gate harrison and quarterback kyler murray furthering their chemistry could well be the team s prevailing storyline this season and that will get going in earnest during camp robinson picked 23 slots after harrison last year played in just six games because of a calf injury this will be a pivotal camp for him especially amid a revamped defensive front one that will offer him veterans to learn from and new faces to compete against for snaps 2 one of the easiest players in the nfl to root for calais campbell 38 returning to the team he began his illustrious career with in 2008 is more than just a feel great story campbell s leadership is just as important an addition as his talent to a club looking for its first winning season since 2021 this is a pivotal season for the monti ossenfort jonathan gannon regime and campbell pass rusher josh sweat and defensive tackle dalvin tomlinson should add some veteran moxie to a team lacking it outside of star safety budda baker gannon was hired for his defensive prowess coordinating the philadelphia eagles now his arizona d is finally stocked up at least on paper it s added some experienced talent and two high profile rookies in defensive lineman walter nolen first round no 16 overall and cornerback will johnson second no 47 johnson has the ceiling to become a massive draft steal how the cards defensive additions mesh with the starting staples begins this summer 3 james conner joined arizona in 2021 and has been a stellar fit who has exceeded his output and importance with the pittsburgh steelers for four years prior he s coming off career high tallies in carries 236 and rushing yards 1 094 but is entering his age 30 season 2024 third rounder trey benson 63 carries for 291 yards had a disappointing debut campaign but if he finds his footing could he push conner for touches it ll be interesting to see how camp develops in the arizona offensive backfield

material_news_signals.headline: NFL QB rankings, Week 3: Patrick Mahomes, Dak Prescott, Matthew Stafford heating up
material_news_signals.description: Thirty passers are on the move in Nick Shook's QB rankings, with Dak Prescott entering the top five. Check out the updated pecking order, 1-32, heading into Week 3 of the 2026 NFL season.
material_news_signals.body_text: notes up down arrows illustrate movement from the week 2 qb index stream live local and prime time games on mobile with nfl tier 1 josh allen can do no wrong following up a four touchdown season debut with a five touchdown showing in week 2 he has an early lead in the mvp race patrick mahomes has proven he s completely back from the knee injury that ended his 2025 season he fired majestic strikes and moved with the full capability that has defined his brand in the win over the colts the fact he s operating in an offense that now has a legitimate running game is an added bonus next gen stats insight via nfl pro mahomes completed 8 of 9 passes for 133 yards and two tds against man coverage in week 1 a contrast to a 2025 campaign in which his 5 0 yards per attempt against man were the second fewest in the nfl and his five ints were tied for second most brock purdy is another early mvp candidate after lighting up the rams and dolphins to start the season posting a league best completion percentage of 80 4 dak prescott got back on track in week 2 dropping an absurd amount of gorgeous dimes on ceedee lamb in a 37 20 romp over washington and reminding the football world of his elite talents yes i called him elite and i m not exaggerating matthew stafford returned to form after looking rusty in his 2026 debut torching the giants by leaning heavily on davante adams jared goff was excellent in the second half of detroit s week 2 loss a reality that will be lost on most who only check final scores for the lions sake hopefully his efforts will produce more wins going forward next gen stats insight via nfl pro goff has the most games with 2 passing touchdowns and zero interceptions in the nfl since the start of 2024 18 2023 25 2022 31 and 2021 35 the year he was traded to the lions tier 2 the bengals were a bit uneven offensively against houston s top tier defense but they won with big plays made possible by joe burrow s arm talent decision making and willingness to let it rip while under duress he and the bengals haven t been consistently explosive through two weeks but burrow deserves credit for going into houston and leading cincinnati to a 14 point win next gen stats insight via nfl pro burrow completed all three of his deep passes 20 air yards to ja marr chase for 73 yards and two tds in week 2 against the texans it was jarring to watch baltimore s offense lose its juice once derrick henry disappeared from the game plan in week 2 and it didn t reflect well on lamar jackson yes he didn t have wr1 zay flowers available but jackson s inability to overcome a surprising change in defensive strategy new orleans decreased its blitz rate in the second half and improved and his game sealing interception dealt a blow to his sparkling reputation for at least one week next gen stats insight via nfl pro jackson used play action on 34 2 of dropbacks against the saints completing 6 of his 10 play action attempts for 101 yards bryce young stacked another excellent showing on top of his season debut making throws that wowed viewers and buoyed his standing in the qb index the confidence and conviction represents a significant step forward for a quarterback who needs a career year ahead of contract talks trevor lawrence was incredibly sharp early in denver fitting passes into tight windows and pushing the jaguars offense forward his dropoff in the second half was disappointing though and contributed directly to jacksonville s defeat tier 3 tyler shough has an obvious clutch gene and unchecked bravery that has already propelled two second half comebacks this season and powered the saints to one of the biggest upsets of week 2 it sure helps that chris olave is blossoming a product of a symbiotic relationship between quarterback and receiver next gen stats insight via nfl pro shough completed 10 of his 13 attempts against the blitz for 113 yards a career high mark while also going 17 for 21 for 139 yards and a touchdown when facing four or fewer rushers drew lock lit up arizona in his first start in place of the injured sam darnold throwing without fear and reaping the benefits he steadied the seahawks offense in a situation that could have taken a downward turn with a lesser quarterback next gen stats insight via nfl pro lock completed 7 of 11 downfield pass attempts 10 air yards for 175 yards in week 2 against the cardinals the second most of his career along with two touchdowns jalen hurts tossed a couple of interceptions against the titans but he also pushed the eagles to victory with his late game heroics with a j brown no longer in the mix in philly hurts rapport with devonta smith is among the most enjoyable developments of the early portion of 2026 c j stroud has played well at times in the first two weeks but he hasn t yet strung together a complete performance next gen stats insight via nfl pro through two weeks stroud leads the league in dropbacks 104 and pass attempts 93 only 10 8 of his pass attempts have been thrown at or behind the line of scrimmage the second lowest rate in the league jayden daniels played really well in the first half of washington s week 2 loss and likely would have kept the game close to the very end had he not suffered a dislocated left elbow on the final play of the second quarter it s a massively disappointing development for both the commanders and fans of electrifying quarterback play brian flores vikings defense got after caleb williams whose fast and loose playing style burned him when he attempted an off balance throw on the run that resulted in an interception williams still had his moments but he couldn t overcome the elements or minnesota s aggression and his hamstring injury was an awful way to end his day we ll all hope williams can return near full strength before long because he s so fun to watch tier 4 jordan love was thrown into the rain at metlife stadium in week 2 and unsurprisingly he struggled he did manage to lead a comeback victory with an offense that lacks any semblance of a running game though he ll need to improve before long or else he ll continue to hover around the dalton line daniel jones did his best to keep the colts in a thrilling sunday night contest and nearly threw them to victory next gen stats insight via nfl pro jones used play action on 51 5 of his dropbacks vs the chiefs his second highest rate in a game in his career and was effective when doing so completing 14 of his 16 attempts for 159 yards and a touchdown his second most yards on play action passes in a game in his career kirk cousins has been tremendously fun to watch especially for fans of grizzled veterans who might be getting their final chance to play meaningful football before father time arrives cousins play against the chargers was heroic at times and he s done a great job of quieting the conversation regarding rookie fernando mendoza s eventual rise to the top job next gen stats insight via nfl pro cousins joined tom brady 2021 2015 and peyton manning 2014 as the only quarterbacks age 38 or older with at least three touchdown passes in each of his team s first two games of a season drake maye played better against the steelers than the 20 3 final score suggested but the patriots have a problem with finishing drives maye still isn t close to the elite quarterback he was in 2025 tier 5 justin herbert isn t the main reason the chargers are 0 2 he s made plenty of excellent throws but he also isn t helping los angeles in key moments when taking unnecessary risks that result in turnovers next gen stats insight via nfl pro herbert has gone 0 for 7 with two ints on tight window throws this season less than one yard of separation while attempting those throws at a 13 0 clip a mark just below the nfl average 14 3 geno smith s solid start carried over into week 2 for a portion of the contest but the weather didn t help his efforts in a disappointing loss bo nix and the broncos still have a problem with starting slowly and nix continues to vacillate between a quarterback who can make incredible throws and commit maddening mistakes next gen stats insight via nfl pro nix completed 16 of 17 passes against four or fewer rushers for 205 yards and a td in week 2 against the jaguars tied for the second highest completion percentage when not facing the blitz by any quarterback since the start of last season min 10 attempts jaxson dart s encouraging start to 2026 was interrupted by a knee injury that wiped out the rest of his season throwing the giants into a depressing and familiar scenario from which they thought they d graduated tier 6 cam ward and the titans were much better offensively in week 2 they gave the eagles a four quarter battle most didn t expect to see ward appears to be gaining confidence in brian daboll s offense and has regained some of his playmaking ability that drove optimism after his rookie season although there s still plenty of room to grow it was nice to see deshaun watson produce competent play on a sunday it wasn t great by any means nor was it pretty but watson keyed a second half comeback that saw the browns outscore the buccaneers 17 3 to finish the game including a 55 yard catch and run touchdown for rookie denzel boston his second in as many weeks and a third down completion to tight end blake whiteheart for the game winning score that s exponentially better than anything i ve written about watson in about two years which is worthy of a bump next gen stats insight via nfl pro watson is the first starting qb to lead a fourth quarter comeback to snap a 6 game personal losing streak since justin fields 2025 jacoby brissett played better against the seahawks than his stat line suggested in the first half by leaning heavily on trey mcbride for two quarters it appeared as if brissett might go toe to toe with drew lock that optimism faded in a lopsided second half in which brissett couldn t overcome the suffocating seattle defense next gen stats insight via nfl pro brissett was under pressure on 41 9 of dropbacks in week 2 against the seahawks completing 4 of 11 passes for 9 yards with an int under pressure and 13 of 17 for 86 yards and a td from a clean pocket we have real reason to be concerned about tampa bay s offense a scheme in which baker mayfield simply appears uncomfortable and uncertain i m not sure there s a quick fix to this issue either a frantic skittish mayfield isn t going to be capable of overcoming an offense that lacks identity rhythm and confidence tier 7 malik willis is trying his best to lead an offense that simply doesn t take care of the details and carries one of the lowest ceilings in the nfl it s not necessarily his fault but it s clear he s not quite the quarterback who can carry an undermanned team to victory at this stage in his career aaron rodgers age was painfully obvious in new england on sunday his offensive line struggled to protect him his receivers didn t help him and he didn t look like he enjoyed his job very much somehow an offense with more freedom to be aggressive has produced worse results and at 42 years old it looks like rodgers isn t capable of overcoming these challenges right now next gen stats insight via nfl pro rodgers finished with 187 passing yards 0 touchdowns and 1 int his fifth straight start with one passing td or fewer tied for the second longest such streak of his career carson wentz s performance was entirely forgettable in a rainy 9 3 victory in chicago we ll see if kyler murray s return can get the offense back on track cooper rush has been the worst quarterback in the nfl through two weeks but thankfully michael penix is returning to the lineup this week we ll see if his style of play fits better than that of rush who wasn t helped much by an underperforming offensive line

material_news_signals.headline: NFL Week 2 Sunday aftermath: Surprising Raiders, soaring Chiefs and sinking Chargers in spotlight
material_news_signals.description: How surprising is the Raiders' 2-0 start? Are Patrick Mahomes and the Chiefs truly BACK? Can anyone handle Brian Flores' blitz-happy defense? NFL.com senior news writer Kevin Patra digs into the top storylines coming out of Week 2 of the 2026 NFL season.
material_news_signals.body_text: following the scoring splurge in week 1 defenses struck back on sunday the 13 afternoon games on sunday averaged 36 8 points boosted by the two prime time contests the league wide average of 40 9 points per tilt in week 2 is down significantly from week 1 s mark of 49 4 ppg with monday night football remaining five defenses held their opponents without a touchdown on sunday carolina chicago cincinnati minnesota and new england it s notable that two of those teams the bears and panthers were involved in a 96 point week 1 bout the week to week flip underscores that clubs are still figuring themselves out early in the 2026 campaign two high profile quarterback injuries jayden daniels dislocated left elbow and caleb williams hamstring will hover over the early portion of the week as we wait to better understand the extent of those players potential absences let s look at the rest of the aftermath of sunday s showdowns including chiefs prove they re back with ot victory vikings d dominates in gritty win at chicago cowboys get back on track as dak passes romo concern brewing for these four offenses one defender who stuffed the stat sheet in week 2 but first a look at some unexpected developments in the young season raiders lead surprising 2 0 teams if we were ranking the most stunning teams to begin this season at 2 0 we d start with the las vegas raiders then there would be a wide football field long gap before the next squad klint kubiak and co took care of business in the opener against a miami team they were supposed to beat they were expected to be a doormat in l a in week 2 nope instead the raiders sent the chargers spiraling with a 26 14 win outplaying their opponents in all three facets that isn t something we ve been able to say about the silver and black in a long long time it s not just that vegas won its first two games it s that the raiders are winning by being the more professional team in years past the raiders have bungled themselves into the turf they were the ones turning the ball over in key spots making mental mistakes and taking brutal drive killing penalties sunday they were the even keeled squad letting the chargers dunk on themselves vegas capitalized at every turn kirk cousins is far from perfect but the 38 year old can still sling it on throws of 10 plus air yards against the bolts cousins was 8 of 12 for 181 yards three touchdowns and one interception per nfl research the 40 yard touchdown pass to tre tucker was just the third completed pass of 40 plus air yards by a raiders qb over the past three seasons kubiak has modernized the offense while rob leonard s defense has swarmed forcing five turnovers over two games the raiders had 16 takeaways all of last year soberly i anticipate the positive vibes from the raiders first 2 0 start since 2021 to be curtailed particularly as the schedule picks up in october however the building blocks of the future are more visible than at any time in recent memory and that s without the no 1 overall pick fernando mendoza at the helm yet the bengals would probably rank as the next most surprising 2 0 squad not because of the record but because of how they ve won their games on the back of the defense as joe burrow got battered and the offense scuffled for much of sunday s contest in houston the defense kept giving c j stroud and the texans fits the run defense turnaround led by dexter lawrence and jonathan allen has completely flipped how the bengals can play a year ago they were getting gashed as the young linebackers struggled through two weeks with the big boys creating havoc and taking up blockers demetrius knight and barrett carter have played more fluidly sure the young lbs still have some coverage issues but their performance has improved significantly on sunday the bengals did not allow a single touchdown their first game allowing zero tds since a 27 12 road win over the jets back in week 3 of 2022 per nfl research of course there was still the joe burrow ja 39 marr chase magic to put cincy over the top but this was a game the bengals lose with last year s defense while we re here this is how i d rank the eight 2 0 teams with the giants looking to join the list by beating the rams on monday night starting with the most impressive through two weeks buffalo bills san francisco 49ers seattle seahawks kansas city chiefs minnesota vikings cincinnati bengals las vegas raiders philadelphia eagles chiefs mahomes prove they are back trailing the colts in the third quarter and facing a third and 11 patrick mahomes uncorked a 45 yard bomb to tyquan thornton to put the chiefs on the doorstep of a go ahead touchdown the heave underscored that a mahomes is fully back and b the chiefs offense can finally return to being a field stretching menace k c turned back the clock on sunday night with travis kelce looking spry and gobbling up 101 yards and mahomes dropping bombs in the ot win the qb threw for 382 passing yards and three tds while playing near flawless football the presence of kenneth walker has completely unlocked the chiefs offense the rb wasn t as dynamic on sunday night as he was in week 1 yet he still bulldozed his way for 117 yards on 24 carries the threat of walker however is a massive boon to mahomes it opens up the play action in a way the two time mvp hasn t had in the past against indy he recorded a career high 14 completions on play action passes per next gen stats across 17 play action attempts he totaled 137 yards and two touchdowns also after failing to complete a downfield pass in week 1 mahomes finished with six completions on nine downfield attempts 10 air yards for 154 yards after years of living in an offensive box and having to manufacture scores the hard way while leaning on the defense the chiefs attack finally looks like it inhaled fresh oxygen vikings dominant d here to stay boy the vikings can coach the early front runners for coach of the year and assistant coach of the year should both reside in minnesota kevin o connell has made the offense work without his starting quarterback and one of his top running backs starting in place of kyler murray carson wentz struggled in the rain soaked soldier field conditions but unlike in previous years wentz avoided the catastrophic turnover that might have sunk his team the far more impressive unit however belongs to brian flores the vikings defense has been the biggest game changer in a young season the ferocious d flipped the script on green bay in week 1 then smothered a bears team that had just put up 59 points keeping ben johnson s offense out of the end zone for 60 minutes in a 9 3 win flores blitzed caleb williams on 27 of his 33 dropbacks 81 8 before he exited the game in the fourth quarter that blitz rate would have ranked as the third highest mark in a game by a defense since at least 2018 per ngs flores ability to create havoc without confusing his own players or giving up a trove of big plays on the back end is impressive other teams could try it and get repeatedly burned for flores it s a style it s doubly remarkable given the questions minnesota entered the season with on the back end isaiah rodgers has been studly so far and the return of veteran safety harrison smith has been a godsend dallas turner has come on strong in year 3 the former first round pick generated 10 pressures including two sacks on 36 pass rushes against the bears marking his second straight week with double digit pressures per ngs five of the pressures on sunday were unblocked a credit to flores discombobulating the offense as minnesota s offense continues to figure things out flores defense has the muscle and guts to keep the vikes on the winning track boys back on track after dak s record day after the prime time week 1 dud in new york dallas showed its high octane potential in an easy home win over the commanders with dak prescott tossing four touchdown strikes to break tony romo s all time franchise record of 248 passing tds it s quite impressive for a former fourth rounder to put himself in a spot not only to break records but to sprint past them sometimes it s great being naive and i was a little naive just growing up thinking that i could do this and i could do that but yet i think it put such insurmountable belief in my head that i can accomplish whatever i want to accomplish prescott said after the game and any thought that i said or anything that i wanted to do and i mentioned it and i said it out loud i had a mom and i had brothers who poured gas on those thoughts who told me i could and as i said you can call it arrogance you can call it confidence belief whatever you need to i wouldn t be here if i didn t have those thoughts if i didn t believe in myself like that and i just encourage the next little kid out there who comes from the trailer park in louisiana or wherever he may come from and doesn t know if he can do it or have the resources or have the family that you re right believe in what you want to believe in and find the people that support that and you can do it the cowboys continue to have issues with their revamped defense under christian parker the injuries aren t helping but dallas had far too many breakdowns against washington especially early some of the issues are of the mental variety and can be cleaned up sunday was reminiscent of 2025 when the cowboys needed big offensive performances to earn ws fortunately for brian schottenheimer when dak spins it like he did against the commanders few defenses can keep him quiet the hope is that eventually the defense catches up are these four offenses in trouble week 2 sunday spotlight

news_mentions.body_text: it s never good to start your season 0 2 it s not a death knell either a year ago three of the 10 teams that started the season 0 2 made their way to the postseason the chicago bears houston texans and carolina panthers it marked the second straight season three clubs started 0 2 and made the playoffs thank you expanded playoff 17 games and pervasive parity since 1990 only 38 of 288 0 2 clubs 12 8 made the postseason 21 won a division title 7 and three took home a lombardi trophy 1 1993 dallas cowboys after emmitt smith ended his holdout 2001 new england patriots tom brady made his first career start in week 3 2007 new york giants who won their next six games and became the first nfc wild card team to win a super bowl the texans find themselves on this list for the second straight season needing to dig themselves out of an early season hole that provides little room for further missteps given their experience and tough opening slate demeco ryans squad leads my yearly ranking of 0 2 teams i still believe in

news_mentions.headline: Notable injuries, news from Sunday's Week 2 games: Packers WR Jayden Reed (neck) carted off vs. Jets
news_mentions.description: Here are the injuries and news we're monitoring around the league on this Week 2 Sunday.
news_mentions.body_text: here are the injuries and news we re monitoring around the league on this week 2 sunday arizona cardinals cornerback max melton toe was ruled out of sunday s game against the seahawks atlanta falcons cornerback a j terrell groin was ruled out of sunday s loss to the panthers defensive end samson ebukam hamstring also was ruled out baltimore ravens offensive tackle ronnie stanley toe did not return to sunday s loss to the saints carolina panthers safety nick scott abdomen was ruled out of sunday s win over the falcons chicago bears quarterback caleb williams was carted to the locker room after suffering a hamstring injury during the fourth quarter of sunday s loss to vikings dallas cowboys cornerback cobie durant hamstring and safety p j locke foot did not to return to sunday s game against the commanders green bay packers wide receiver jayden reed exited sunday s win over the jets on a stretcher after he was hit in the head area by a defender in the first quarter he was quickly ruled out with a neck injury coach matt lafleur said after the game that reed has movement in his extremities and will remain in the new jersey area overnight offensive tackle zach bako bewele knee was carted off the field with an air cast placed on his injured leg bako bewele also was ruled out guard aaron banks toe was ruled out in the fourth quarter and defensive tackle anthony campbell ankle did not return indianapolis colts wide receiver alec pierce was carted to the locker room during the first half versus the chiefs and ruled out with a heel injury x rays were negative but pierce who was in a boot and using crutches after the game will undergo further testing on monday per espn cb charvarius ward left sunday night s loss with a groin injury los angeles chargers tight end david njoku knee was ruled out of sunday s loss to the raiders miami dolphins running back jaylen wright stinger and defensive end robert beal hamstring did not return to sunday s loss to san francisco minnesota vikings defensive lineman tyrion ingram dawkins hip did not return to sunday s win over the bears new england patriots offensive lineman mike onwenu ankle was ruled out in the first half of sunday s win over the steelers espn com reported after the game that initial x rays showed onwenu broke his right ankle tight end eli raridon thigh also was ruled out linebacker dre 39 mont jones shoulder and safety dell pettus ankle did not return new york jets defensive lineman david onyemata groin was ruled out of sunday s loss to the packers linebackers marcelino mccrary ball ankle and kiko mauigoa quad also did not return philadelphia eagles tight end dallas goedert knee did not return to sunday s win over the titans running back saquon barkley missed most of the first half after suffering a stinger barkley returned to the field after halftime barkley said after the game that he will undergo an mri pittsburgh steelers running back rico dowdle toe missed part of the first half of sunday s loss to the patriots before returning after halftime san francisco 49ers receiver demarcus robinson ankle was ruled out of sunday s game against the dolphins head coach kyle shanahan told reporters after the game robinson and dt james thompson have high ankle sprains wide receiver mike evans hip did not return to the game but the injury doesn t look serious per shanahan seattle seahawks running back jadarian price chest did not return to sunday s game against the cardinals hc mike macdonald said after the game that x rays came back negative on price s injury washington commanders quarterback jayden daniels dislocated his left elbow in sunday s loss to the cowboys head coach dan quinn said quinn told reporters that an x ray on daniels elbow didn t show a fracture but the qb will undergo more testing daniels was ruled out after getting injured at the end of the first half versus dallas he was seen leaving the stadium with his arm in a sling per local reporters sunday s game between the cleveland browns and tampa bay buccaneers was suspended in the fourth quarter due to lightning in the area the delay lasted over two hours before play resumed at 6 10 p m et

news_mentions.body_text: with 2026 training camps just around the corner it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams kevin patra has the lowdown on the key position battles and top storylines to monitor for the houston texans indianapolis colts jacksonville jaguars and tennessee titans catch up on each afc south team s offseason developments and 2026 outlook below houston texans indianapolis colts jacksonville jaguars tennessee titans three key storylines 1 another o line overhaul the most glaring weakness of the 2025 texans will take center stage during training camp as houston once again undergoes an offensive line revamp demeco ryans crew re upped right guard ed ingram and left tackle aireontae ersery showed glimpses of promise during his up and down rookie campaign the texans drafted center guard keylan rutledge in the first round they inked guard wyatt teller and right tackle braden smith both solid veterans when healthy in free agency veteran trent brown and 2024 second rounder blake fisher will battle for reps and or the swing tackle gig and evan brown and fourth round rookie febechi nwaiwu provide depth inside on paper it s a significantly improved group from the one that got bowled over a year ago however we ve said that before paper can get shredded just like last year s o line in houston how the crew shakes out will be the key to camp and how the texans season unfolds 2 can stroud offense get back on track tied to the first point is the play of c j stroud who has seen his production dip the past two seasons after a sensational rookie campaign in 2023 stroud s collapse reached a low with his ghastly performance see four interceptions 42 6 completion rate in the playoff loss to the new england patriots stroud has been scattershot behind a woeful offensive line at times last year he trusted his blocking so little that even when he had time he d rush decisions and make panicked throws the qb s play has been so incongruous to the poise and calm he displayed as a rookie that it s maddening for the offense to get back in gear and stop wasting a championship worthy defense stroud must be more consistent in the pocket an improved offensive line will certainly help but the qb must raise all boats even when the situation isn t perfect getting better run production with the import of david montgomery should improve the offensive efficiency monty rarely gets stuffed for negative gains solving a problem we saw far too often from houston s ground game a year ago he should keep the offense in better down and distances one other key player to track during camp is receiver tank dell who has been out since late in the 2024 season due to a severe knee injury the difference in stroud s production with and without dell in the lineup is stark what sort of shape will the receiver be in after so much time away and can he stay healthy 3 rich defense gets richer can the most ferocious defense in the league actually be better in 2026 edge monsters will anderson and danielle hunter are still in their primes derek stingley kamari lassiter jalen pitre and calen bullock form a lockdown backend and azeez al shaair still patrols the middle the texans upgraded a safety spot with veteran reed blankenship after shuffling through others at the position second round pick kayden mcdonald could play a significant role out of the gate alongside sheldon rankins and tommy togiai in the middle of the d line if mcdonald turns out to be a steal this defense will have zero weaknesses back to top three key storylines 1 how will jones look in return from injury daniel jones progress is the no 1 topic in indianapolis entering camp the colts predictably held the starter out of team drills during offseason workouts but expect him to be full go sometime during camp the focus will be on how many reps he can take and how he looks indy was a wonder early last season when jones was on his game making plays and looking at home in shane steichen s offense it fell apart when the qb got hurt the colts put all their eggs in the basket of jones returning healthy this offseason achilles injuries however can be a slog to return from yes jones is younger than kirk cousins but we saw how long it took for the latter to return to anything close to what he was before such an injury and cousins never relied on his mobility like jones does if jones is stuck in the pocket or struggles to push off the injured leg leading to limp passes will the colts offense wither how he looks early in camp won t say everything but it will give a strong indication of what to expect for the first quarter of the season in concert the colts will conduct a backup qb competition between anthony richardson and riley leonard barring richardson s trade request being granted of course given jones injury history the winner could see reps this season 2 overall roster health health is the main storyline throughout the colts roster from jones to alec pierce on offense to key defenders like deforest buckner and sauce gardner on defense buckner is one to track on d the colts have no replacement for the star dt who underwent neck surgery last winter he could be ready for week 1 but at this point it remains an unknown he was noncommittal when asked this offseason given how much of the summer months are filled with players dismissing injury and assuming they ll be ready it s a red flag when a veteran is evasive if buckner misses the start of the season or sees his play dip it could be devastating for indy s defense how much he participates in camp if at all will be closely tracked there isn t the same concern with gardner who missed significant time last season with a lingering calf injury but the star s status is worth keeping an eye on we also aren t sure what charvarius ward will look like after deciding against retiring following last year s concussion issues outside of injury questions what will the pass rush look like is laiatu latu ready to make a leap how much does arden key still have left is jt tuimoloau ready for a bigger role do the colts need to bring in another veteran edge 3 taylor s future in indy outside of health concerns hovering over colts camp the future of jonathan taylor is an interesting question the 27 year old running back is in the final year of his contract the situation is far less contentious than the last time he sought a new pact which saw him conduct a hold in until he got paid when asked about his contract this summer taylor was cordial about the state of affairs but made it known he d like to continue getting paid in indy could the situation turn sour again will the rb decide to ratchet things up if no extension comes before camp perhaps he s waiting for bijan robinson and jahmyr gibbs to reset the market again before making his next play we saw the offense s struggles when jones was out as defenses could sell out to stop jt it wasn t pretty if taylor is going to be asked to keep carrying a hefty load with little aid he might want commensurate compensation into the future back to top three key storylines 1 backfield shakeup when travis etienne signed in new orleans it opened up a swath of carries bhayshul tuten who has impressed this offseason is expected to have a hefty role but it s still unclear how big that part might be as free agent addition chris rodriguez was unable to participate in offseason workouts following a surgical procedure on his left foot the veteran is expected to be good to go for training camp which will give us a better idea of how liam coen might divvy up his rb reps last year etienne took the overwhelming majority of carries 260 to tuten s 83 will coen slice up the pie more or ride tuten at least to start the season a lot might have to do with rodriguez s health 2 what will hunter s role be when it was reported that the jags planned for the former no 2 overall pick to be a primary corner and part time receiver travis hunter didn t seem to take too kindly to that plan we won t know the truth until hunter is on the field for a significant amount of time how much he participates early in camp and where that participation takes place will indicate the club s intentions if the second year dual threat player is the lockdown corner most believe he s capable of being and continues to make plays at receiver the jags could have trouble taking him off the gridiron the rest of the offensive playmakers could have some say in how much time hunter sees at wr after a disappointing second season brian thomas has received glowing reviews this offseason parker washington soared to close last season and jakobi meyers remains a consistent professional if btj gets back on track there could be less of a reason to use hunter in a ton of offensive sets 3 lloyd s replacement the jags saw devin lloyd leave in free agency and didn t replace his production in anthony campanile s defense via free agency or early in the draft the decision puts 2023 fourth rounder ventrell miller in line to take over the role next to foye oluokun miller showed spunk this offseason but won t be handed the starting gig 2025 undrafted lb branson combs and 2026 seventh rounder parker hughes could have a shot to push miller for the starting gig if no one comes to the forefront the jags d could be in a rough spot lloyd shined last year under campanile who unleashed the linebacker s athleticism in a second team all pro campaign lacking playmaking in the middle would highlight some of the questions up front where there wasn t always consistent pressure from the front four back to top three key storylines 1 cam ward cam ward cam ward when discussing critical elements for the 2026 tennessee titans point nos 1 through 50 could all be about cam ward that s how vital his development is to any success in nashville robert saleh brings a professional coach to the head chair and did well to import brian daboll to nurture the young quarterback perhaps daboll wasn t meant for the head coaching gig in new york but he s proven he can help grow a qb josh allen daniel jones and jaxson dart all improved under daboll ward offers enticing upside while his accuracy came and went last year when he was in a groove the titans qb showcased a laser arm and the ability to find the range deep he needs to calibrate his short to mid area throws at times but the alluring positives pop off the page he doesn t need to live in the acrobatic athletic plays but they can add an indefensible element to tennessee s offense improving his mental processing particularly against man coverage where he struggled is one of the early steps ward has to make this season the titans must see significant strides forward from their qb in year 2 after the club improved his surroundings 2 better receiving corps in attempting to make life easier for ward tennessee upgraded the wr room first they inked wan 39 dale robinson from new york the slot maven excelled in daboll s offense and can help teach a young wideout room the ropes robinson is coming off a 1 014 yard season and generated a career high 11 yards per catch in 2025 the veteran will be particularly helpful to ward on third downs when he can win from the slot and make himself available to the quarterback then the titans used the no 4 overall pick on ohio state wr carnell tate who provides a vertical threat and heady playmaking tate s ability to make catches in close knit areas will be a boon for his new qb second year wrs elic ayomanor and chimere dike both showed glimmers of promise during their rookie campaigns if they take a step forward this could be an enticing group the lingering question is what role calvin ridley will play the veteran struggled on the field and missed the bulk of the season due to injury in seven tilts he had just 303 yards on 17 catches with zero tds his 11 1 drop rate last season was fifth worst in the nfl minimum 25 targets per next gen stats the titans eschewed cutting ridley believing he can still aid ward and the offense what that role is will be determined during camp 3 will improved d on paper translate to field the titans sported a woeful defense last season with saleh taking over the club the unit was completely revamped on paper it s much improved but how will all the new pieces mesh i love adding a penetrating john franklin myers next to all world dt jeffery simmons however is there enough on the edges jermaine johnson had his best years under saleh but hasn t been a consistent force first round rookie keldric faulk boasts talent but will he be a day 1 difference maker will second round rookie linebacker anthony hill immediately step into the middle of the defense next to the underrated cedric gray the secondary was horrendous last season tennessee responded by signing cordale flott alontae taylor and joshua williams all have had moments in their careers when they ve been stellar but there is also a reason each was available namely inconsistency i trust saleh to know how he wants his d to run and to get the most out of his players there is no question this crew is significantly improved on paper but questions remain particularly with all the free agent veteran additions back to top

news_mentions.headline: AFC West training camp 2026 preview: Top storylines for Broncos, Chargers, Chiefs, Raiders
news_mentions.description: As we hurtle toward the 2026 NFL season, Bobby Kownack breaks down the top AFC West training camp storylines to monitor for the Denver Broncos, Kansas City Chiefs, Las Vegas Raiders and Los Angeles Chargers.
news_mentions.body_text: with 2026 training camps just around the corner it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams bobby kownack has the lowdown on the key position battles and top storylines to monitor for the denver broncos kansas city chiefs las vegas raiders and los angeles chargers catch up on each afc west team s offseason developments and 2026 outlook below denver broncos kansas city chiefs las vegas raiders los angeles chargers three key storylines 1 nix s health receiving corps bo nix should be full go for training camp after suffering a broken ankle in last season s divisional round win but every step in the process bears watching when someone this important to a franchise is returning from injury once nix is out there eyes will also be glued to his pass catching group denver gifted its qb with a second no 1 wideout by trading for jaylen waddle to pair with courtland sutton and camp should provide the first hints as to whether the broncos will employ them as a 1a 1b combo or settle into a more defined pecking order plus can anyone from a proven supporting cast of troy franklin marvin mims and pat bryant emerge as the clear third option 2 denver has a new play caller reaching the doorstep of the super bowl didn t prevent sean payton from enacting sizable changes to the offensive staff he fired offensive coordinator joe lombardi two days after denver s afc title game loss and bumped davis webb up to replace him a month later payton publicly transferred play calling duties to the 31 year old former quarterback it s been a meteoric rise for webb who entered the coaching ranks as payton s qbs coach in 2023 webb has been learning under payton since then so nothing will be unrecognizable but nix still will need to get used to a new voice in his helmet any improvement for a 14th ranked scoring offense on a team that already won 14 games last season would be massive in the afc race 3 broncos are largely running it back roster wise the 2026 broncos are the personification of if it ain t broke don t fix it they took the big swing for waddle but barely signed any outside free agents denver instead focused on retaining talent losing defensive lineman john franklin myers and releasing linebacker dre greenlaw but basically keeping the band together even in the draft the club didn t make a pick until the third round apart from working waddle into the mix with webb now calling the shots the broncos can hit the ground running while many other contenders must start off with finding chemistry that s huge considering how unfriendly the first month and a half of denver s schedule appears at chiefs vs jaguars vs rams at 49ers at chargers and vs seahawks back to top three key storylines 1 when will mahomes be fully healthy patrick mahomes said during the offseason program that he s in a good spot in his acl lcl recovery and hopes to play in week 1 while andy reid told reporters the quarterback should be able to do some things at the start of training camp so how much will mahomes take on when the chiefs report and how quickly will he ramp up activity those questions don t have answers at the moment the chiefs hopes of returning to contention in 2026 and beyond rely heavily on the two time most valuable player so they ll be smart with him justin fields now on his fourth team in as many years could be one of the league s most intensely scrutinized backups as mahomes return timeline takes shape 2 kansas city s cb room begins anew again the chiefs have a habit of maximizing young cornerbacks talent and moving on before the bill comes due most recently they traded two time all pro trent mcduffie and let jaylen watson walk in free agency with both cover men going to the rams kansas city will call on 2025 third rounder nohl williams and mansoor delane this year s no 6 overall pick to fill the void fourth round rookie jadon canady should also be in competition for playing time with free agent signees kader kohou and l 39 jarius sneed the latter of whom returns to kansas city a couple of years after the team traded him to tennessee defensive coordinator steve spagnuolo s track record which includes three straight top six defenses in points allowed suggests things will work out just fine 3 bieniemy s back kansas city s offensive coordinator position has been devalued for years overshadowed by the prowess of patrick mahomes and andy reid perhaps it shouldn t have been during eric bieniemy s five years as the team s oc from 2018 through 2022 the chiefs never finished worse than sixth in the league in points or yards twice tallied the most points and three times amassed the most yards in the last three years without bieniemy the chiefs have ranked at average 17th in scoring and 15th in yardage there were obviously other factors in the decline such as tyreek hill exiting in a trade and travis kelce aging out of his prime but bieniemy returning still bodes well back to top three key storylines 1 mendoza s first camp the future of the raiders now rests on no 1 pick fernando mendoza s shoulders even if he isn t destined to start right away new head coach klint kubiak has communicated that his ideal scenario is to avoid putting a rookie under center in week 1 and by signing veteran kirk cousins las vegas essentially ensured mendoza s starting debut will come via choice rather than need still mendoza is coming off a perfect 16 0 season in which he took home the heisman trophy and led indiana to a national championship he s going to show up for the competition and all the buzz at raiders camp will revolve around him when he does 2 who steps up at wr las vegas has some starry names on offense quarterback fernando mendoza running back ashton jeanty and tight end brock bowers at wide receiver though there s work to do tre tucker was easily the team s most trustworthy wideout last year but he doesn t really profile as a wr1 jack bech and dont 39 e thornton 2025 second and fourth round picks respectively are looking to rebound from underwhelming rookie seasons free agent addition jalen nailor has a chance to show staying power in a larger role after flashing promise with 858 yards and 10 tds on 57 catches over the past two years with the vikings those are likely las vegas top four in some order but there s still a lot to shake out during the preseason 3 crosby s defense 2 0 in the four days between the raiders agreeing to send maxx crosby to the ravens and baltimore backing out of the trade las vegas spent a whole lot of dough rebuilding its defense for what was supposed to be the post crosby era now thanks to the blockbuster deal falling apart crosby is very much a part of the present the five time pro bowler returned to possibly the most talented unit the raiders have had during his career the linebacking corps has been rebuilt with nakobe dean and quay walker taron johnson brings more legitimacy to the cornerback room and kwity paye is set to line up on the edge opposite crosby reason for excitement in sin city extends far beyond the team s top picked qb back to top three key storylines 1 mcdaniel effect it was time for a change after the chargers scored 15 combined points in their last two wild card exits jim harbaugh fired offensive coordinator greg roman a longtime collaborator and replaced him with mike mcdaniel to hopefully supercharge the offense as the former dolphins coach did in his first couple years with miami mcdaniel s arrival as a quarterback whisperer is good news for justin herbert who already plays at a pro bowl level but the impact of his high octane system should be felt everywhere from the promising tight end trio of oronde gadsden david njoku and charlie kolar to omarion hampton in the backfield 2 fingers crossed for l a s o line los angeles offensive line should be a strength of the team in 2026 after disaster struck last season left tackle rashawn slater suffered a season ending patellar tendon tear in august while right tackle joe alt played just six games before requiring season ending ankle surgery herbert took a career high 54 sacks behind a patchwork offensive line leading the league with 268 pressures taken and a 43 3 pressure rate slater and alt are back but they ll also be joined on the line by free agent signings tyler biadasz and cole strange as well as second round rookie jake slaughter assuming the group stays healthy herbert should be well protected first though the bolts blockers have to jell together as a unit in august 3 chargers hope they have an edge rushing duo to build around the offseason didn t bring any sweeping changes for the chargers defense dalvin tomlinson 32 was their most notable signing to bulk up the interior and they lost a few pass rushers odafe oweh and da 39 shawn hand but largely maintained the status quo los angeles did however spend a first round pick on akheem mesidor the acc sack leader in 2025 with 12 5 there s enough pass rushing depth that mesidor won t have to take on too much too soon more importantly he has some stellar mentors in tuli tuipulotu who was sixth in the nfl last season with 13 sacks and nine time pro bowler khalil mack the hope is for a seamless transition from mack to mesidor alongside tuipulotu as the leaders of the l a edge rush back to top
