news_mentions.description: Which of the league's eight 0-2 teams still have playoff hopes? NFL.com's Kevin Patra ranks this year's set of winless squads entering a pivotal Week 3.
news_mentions.body_text: it s never good to start your season 0 2 it s not a death knell either a year ago three of the 10 teams that started the season 0 2 made their way to the postseason the chicago bears houston texans and carolina panthers it marked the second straight season three clubs started 0 2 and made the playoffs thank you expanded playoff 17 games and pervasive parity since 1990 only 38 of 288 0 2 clubs 12 8 made the postseason 21 won a division title 7 and three took home a lombardi trophy 1 1993 dallas cowboys after emmitt smith ended his holdout 2001 new england patriots tom brady made his first career start in week 3 2007 new york giants who won their next six games and became the first nfc wild card team to win a super bowl the texans find themselves on this list for the second straight season needing to dig themselves out of an early season hole that provides little room for further missteps given their experience and tough opening slate demeco ryans squad leads my yearly ranking of 0 2 teams i still believe in

news_mentions.headline: NFL QB rankings, Week 3: Patrick Mahomes, Dak Prescott, Matthew Stafford heating up
news_mentions.description: Thirty passers are on the move in Nick Shook's QB rankings, with Dak Prescott entering the top five. Check out the updated pecking order, 1-32, heading into Week 3 of the 2026 NFL season.
news_mentions.body_text: notes up down arrows illustrate movement from the week 2 qb index stream live local and prime time games on mobile with nfl tier 1 josh allen can do no wrong following up a four touchdown season debut with a five touchdown showing in week 2 he has an early lead in the mvp race patrick mahomes has proven he s completely back from the knee injury that ended his 2025 season he fired majestic strikes and moved with the full capability that has defined his brand in the win over the colts the fact he s operating in an offense that now has a legitimate running game is an added bonus next gen stats insight via nfl pro mahomes completed 8 of 9 passes for 133 yards and two tds against man coverage in week 1 a contrast to a 2025 campaign in which his 5 0 yards per attempt against man were the second fewest in the nfl and his five ints were tied for second most brock purdy is another early mvp candidate after lighting up the rams and dolphins to start the season posting a league best completion percentage of 80 4 dak prescott got back on track in week 2 dropping an absurd amount of gorgeous dimes on ceedee lamb in a 37 20 romp over washington and reminding the football world of his elite talents yes i called him elite and i m not exaggerating matthew stafford returned to form after looking rusty in his 2026 debut torching the giants by leaning heavily on davante adams jared goff was excellent in the second half of detroit s week 2 loss a reality that will be lost on most who only check final scores for the lions sake hopefully his efforts will produce more wins going forward next gen stats insight via nfl pro goff has the most games with 2 passing touchdowns and zero interceptions in the nfl since the start of 2024 18 2023 25 2022 31 and 2021 35 the year he was traded to the lions tier 2 the bengals were a bit uneven offensively against houston s top tier defense but they won with big plays made possible by joe burrow s arm talent decision making and willingness to let it rip while under duress he and the bengals haven t been consistently explosive through two weeks but burrow deserves credit for going into houston and leading cincinnati to a 14 point win next gen stats insight via nfl pro burrow completed all three of his deep passes 20 air yards to ja marr chase for 73 yards and two tds in week 2 against the texans it was jarring to watch baltimore s offense lose its juice once derrick henry disappeared from the game plan in week 2 and it didn t reflect well on lamar jackson yes he didn t have wr1 zay flowers available but jackson s inability to overcome a surprising change in defensive strategy new orleans decreased its blitz rate in the second half and improved and his game sealing interception dealt a blow to his sparkling reputation for at least one week next gen stats insight via nfl pro jackson used play action on 34 2 of dropbacks against the saints completing 6 of his 10 play action attempts for 101 yards bryce young stacked another excellent showing on top of his season debut making throws that wowed viewers and buoyed his standing in the qb index the confidence and conviction represents a significant step forward for a quarterback who needs a career year ahead of contract talks trevor lawrence was incredibly sharp early in denver fitting passes into tight windows and pushing the jaguars offense forward his dropoff in the second half was disappointing though and contributed directly to jacksonville s defeat tier 3 tyler shough has an obvious clutch gene and unchecked bravery that has already propelled two second half comebacks this season and powered the saints to one of the biggest upsets of week 2 it sure helps that chris olave is blossoming a product of a symbiotic relationship between quarterback and receiver next gen stats insight via nfl pro shough completed 10 of his 13 attempts against the blitz for 113 yards a career high mark while also going 17 for 21 for 139 yards and a touchdown when facing four or fewer rushers drew lock lit up arizona in his first start in place of the injured sam darnold throwing without fear and reaping the benefits he steadied the seahawks offense in a situation that could have taken a downward turn with a lesser quarterback next gen stats insight via nfl pro lock completed 7 of 11 downfield pass attempts 10 air yards for 175 yards in week 2 against the cardinals the second most of his career along with two touchdowns jalen hurts tossed a couple of interceptions against the titans but he also pushed the eagles to victory with his late game heroics with a j brown no longer in the mix in philly hurts rapport with devonta smith is among the most enjoyable developments of the early portion of 2026 c j stroud has played well at times in the first two weeks but he hasn t yet strung together a complete performance next gen stats insight via nfl pro through two weeks stroud leads the league in dropbacks 104 and pass attempts 93 only 10 8 of his pass attempts have been thrown at or behind the line of scrimmage the second lowest rate in the league jayden daniels played really well in the first half of washington s week 2 loss and likely would have kept the game close to the very end had he not suffered a dislocated left elbow on the final play of the second quarter it s a massively disappointing development for both the commanders and fans of electrifying quarterback play brian flores vikings defense got after caleb williams whose fast and loose playing style burned him when he attempted an off balance throw on the run that resulted in an interception williams still had his moments but he couldn t overcome the elements or minnesota s aggression and his hamstring injury was an awful way to end his day we ll all hope williams can return near full strength before long because he s so fun to watch tier 4 jordan love was thrown into the rain at metlife stadium in week 2 and unsurprisingly he struggled he did manage to lead a comeback victory with an offense that lacks any semblance of a running game though he ll need to improve before long or else he ll continue to hover around the dalton line daniel jones did his best to keep the colts in a thrilling sunday night contest and nearly threw them to victory next gen stats insight via nfl pro jones used play action on 51 5 of his dropbacks vs the chiefs his second highest rate in a game in his career and was effective when doing so completing 14 of his 16 attempts for 159 yards and a touchdown his second most yards on play action passes in a game in his career kirk cousins has been tremendously fun to watch especially for fans of grizzled veterans who might be getting their final chance to play meaningful football before father time arrives cousins play against the chargers was heroic at times and he s done a great job of quieting the conversation regarding rookie fernando mendoza s eventual rise to the top job next gen stats insight via nfl pro cousins joined tom brady 2021 2015 and peyton manning 2014 as the only quarterbacks age 38 or older with at least three touchdown passes in each of his team s first two games of a season drake maye played better against the steelers than the 20 3 final score suggested but the patriots have a problem with finishing drives maye still isn t close to the elite quarterback he was in 2025 tier 5 justin herbert isn t the main reason the chargers are 0 2 he s made plenty of excellent throws but he also isn t helping los angeles in key moments when taking unnecessary risks that result in turnovers next gen stats insight via nfl pro herbert has gone 0 for 7 with two ints on tight window throws this season less than one yard of separation while attempting those throws at a 13 0 clip a mark just below the nfl average 14 3 geno smith s solid start carried over into week 2 for a portion of the contest but the weather didn t help his efforts in a disappointing loss bo nix and the broncos still have a problem with starting slowly and nix continues to vacillate between a quarterback who can make incredible throws and commit maddening mistakes next gen stats insight via nfl pro nix completed 16 of 17 passes against four or fewer rushers for 205 yards and a td in week 2 against the jaguars tied for the second highest completion percentage when not facing the blitz by any quarterback since the start of last season min 10 attempts jaxson dart s encouraging start to 2026 was interrupted by a knee injury that wiped out the rest of his season throwing the giants into a depressing and familiar scenario from which they thought they d graduated tier 6 cam ward and the titans were much better offensively in week 2 they gave the eagles a four quarter battle most didn t expect to see ward appears to be gaining confidence in brian daboll s offense and has regained some of his playmaking ability that drove optimism after his rookie season although there s still plenty of room to grow it was nice to see deshaun watson produce competent play on a sunday it wasn t great by any means nor was it pretty but watson keyed a second half comeback that saw the browns outscore the buccaneers 17 3 to finish the game including a 55 yard catch and run touchdown for rookie denzel boston his second in as many weeks and a third down completion to tight end blake whiteheart for the game winning score that s exponentially better than anything i ve written about watson in about two years which is worthy of a bump next gen stats insight via nfl pro watson is the first starting qb to lead a fourth quarter comeback to snap a 6 game personal losing streak since justin fields 2025 jacoby brissett played better against the seahawks than his stat line suggested in the first half by leaning heavily on trey mcbride for two quarters it appeared as if brissett might go toe to toe with drew lock that optimism faded in a lopsided second half in which brissett couldn t overcome the suffocating seattle defense next gen stats insight via nfl pro brissett was under pressure on 41 9 of dropbacks in week 2 against the seahawks completing 4 of 11 passes for 9 yards with an int under pressure and 13 of 17 for 86 yards and a td from a clean pocket we have real reason to be concerned about tampa bay s offense a scheme in which baker mayfield simply appears uncomfortable and uncertain i m not sure there s a quick fix to this issue either a frantic skittish mayfield isn t going to be capable of overcoming an offense that lacks identity rhythm and confidence tier 7 malik willis is trying his best to lead an offense that simply doesn t take care of the details and carries one of the lowest ceilings in the nfl it s not necessarily his fault but it s clear he s not quite the quarterback who can carry an undermanned team to victory at this stage in his career aaron rodgers age was painfully obvious in new england on sunday his offensive line struggled to protect him his receivers didn t help him and he didn t look like he enjoyed his job very much somehow an offense with more freedom to be aggressive has produced worse results and at 42 years old it looks like rodgers isn t capable of overcoming these challenges right now next gen stats insight via nfl pro rodgers finished with 187 passing yards 0 touchdowns and 1 int his fifth straight start with one passing td or fewer tied for the second longest such streak of his career carson wentz s performance was entirely forgettable in a rainy 9 3 victory in chicago we ll see if kyler murray s return can get the offense back on track cooper rush has been the worst quarterback in the nfl through two weeks but thankfully michael penix is returning to the lineup this week we ll see if his style of play fits better than that of rush who wasn t helped much by an underperforming offensive line

news_mentions.headline: Giants' Jameis Winston returns to starting QB role after Jaxson Dart injury: 'This is what I dream of'
news_mentions.description: The New York Giants are now Jameis Winston’s team. After being called into emergency action on Monday night in Los Angeles, Winston has a game to prepare for.
news_mentions.body_text: the new york giants are now jameis winston s team it s a product of unfortunate circumstances usual starter jaxson dart suffered a knee injury that will require surgery but there s little time to waste on acknowledging misfortune after being called into emergency action on monday night in los angeles winston has a game to prepare for this is what i ve always dreamed of to be a starting quarterback winston told reporters wednesday ahead of new york s week 3 matchup with tennessee obviously my respects and gratitude is just going to be with jaxson but at the same time this is what i dream of i dream of being what i am right now and executing at a high level winston certainly didn t execute at a high level when he replaced the injured dart on monday night completing 11 of 27 passes for 111 yards and an interception in the 28 6 defeat he s been here before though starting in place of dart for two games last season that both ended in one score losses winston s experience and performance in spot starts convinced the giants to reward him with a two year 13 million extension earlier in september securing a veteran backup they can trust they just didn t expect to have to turn to him so quickly that s life in the nfl as a backup quarterback though and after being one play away from seeing the field winston can count on it for the rest of the regular season it s truly a privilege he said i had this privilege for two games last year it truly was an honor but for this game alone my focus is on being my very best going out there and having elite fundamentals and precise execution and that s what it starts with and it s as simple as that no matter how big it may seem being present and focused on doing all that you can do with what you have with where you are for right now that s keeping jaxson s spirits uplifted and going out there on that football field and being the new york football giants starting quarterback right now winston is a guaranteed manufacturer of fun playing a wild and often reckless style of quarterback with the arm talent and athleticism to produce big plays the former no 1 pick also comes with what is essentially a guarantee to commit crushing mistakes at the worst possible times as the founder of the 30 30 club 30 touchdowns 30 interceptions thrown in a single season winston s unpredictability has defined his career he s liable to throw for 400 yards but he s just as likely to throw three interceptions or a game losing pick six he did all three as a member of the browns in a 2024 loss to denver winston once even called to the heavens for help after throwing an interception returned for a touchdown telling reporters he was praying for the lord to deliver me from pick sixes the giants will want him to be himself but also keep things between the lines it s their best chance of overcoming the loss of dart and proving themselves as a competitive team worthy of new york s support the fans want to see wins winston said it s not about what i m showing them it s about us going out there and winning football games together giving them something to cheer for giving them something to stand behind but right now my heart this is fresh the opportunity is beautiful it s amazing i m grateful for it but at the same time i ve got a brother that i ve got to keep lifted up and i have to prepare for a football game but i ve prepared for many football games and i ve dealt with injury before i ve had an injury that was really bad so balancing the two but keeping a perspective of do what you can with what you have right now where you re at winston and the giants 1 1 host the titans 0 2 on sunday at 1 p m et

news_mentions.headline: Cardinals QB Jacoby Brissett defends Marvin Harrison Jr. amid criticism of slow start
news_mentions.description: Cardinals WR Marvin Harrison has just one catch through two games to start the season. QB Jacoby Brissett defended the wideout when talking to reporters on Wednesday.
news_mentions.body_text: arizona cardinals wide receiver marvin harrison is now in year three of his nfl career and is still hearing the same questions why aren t you more involved in the offense where are the big plays we were promised through two games this season harrison has seen just four targets he s caught one a fantastic snag down the sideline in week 1 for 33 yards production that doesn t match his status as the no 4 overall pick in the 2024 draft pressed for answers after seeing just one target in arizona s lopsided week 2 loss to seattle harrison explained it as a matter of circumstance it s definitely a combination of a lot of things harrison told reporters on wednesday via espn for my route tree getting down the field you need a lot of things to go right you need the right coverage you need protection to hold up you need me to run a great route you need obviously jacoby brissett to make the right pass and make the right read so i feel like it s never one person s fault for anybody s success or lack thereof really so i think it s always a combination of a bunch of things and whether that s a lack of success or success in general it doesn t help that despite spotty at best production harrison is seen as arizona s most dangerous threat in the cardinals receiving corps which will draw additional attention from opposing defenses in arizona s week 1 win over the chargers los angeles only left him on an island in single coverage on seven of the 33 routes he ran he won his only press man matchup a situation in which his size and route running gives him an advantage on the sideline grab his lone contribution to arizona s season opening highlight reel brissett meanwhile leaned heavily on tight end trey mcbride in both games capitalizing on coverage mismatches to the tune of nine completions for 95 yards and a touchdown in week 1 in their low output week 2 contest mcbride was arizona s passing offense logging the most targets 10 and catches 8 for 41 yards and his second touchdown of the season it s clear brissett prefers the playmaking tight end as a reliable target but harrison still looms as a big play threat if given the opportunities which were sparse in their 31 7 loss to the defensively driven reigning champions this past sunday pretty much that simple harrison said seattle s a really good defense and you don t want to give a lot of teams especially a rival team a lot of credit but when you just look across the league they re far beyond above everybody else especially on the defensive side of the football so things like that happen if it were the first slow start for harrison folks might give him grace but through two seasons and the first two weeks of 2026 harrison s productivity hasn t come close to matching his expectations previous struggles were partially pinned on arizona s instability at quarterback with kyler murray s health challenges limiting his availability and hindering their chances of establishing a rapport defensive minded coach jonathan gannon s presence also gave cardinals an easy excuse now though the underwhelming performances are rising to a concerning level coach mike lafleur brings the offensive expertise for which cardinals fans previously yearned yet the initial returns remain the same for harrison he hears the criticism fortunately he also has the support of his quarterback is some of the noise justified brissett said i don t think so personally we just signed mike wilson for 25 million and nobody said anything about him having two catches i think people try to find somewhere to make something out of nothing the only thing you can do is just go out there and just continue to get better as a teammate of him and him as an individual and i think that s what we re doing harrison is no stranger to the spotlight he arrived at ohio state as a top recruit succeeded stars garrett wilson chris olave and jaxon smith njigba the 2025 nfl offensive player of the year in columbus and knew he d be a top pick in the 2024 nfl draft he just hasn t delivered on those expectations yet no he said when asked if he was surprised by the public reaction to his slow start i mean i understand who i am and what i was expected to do when i got drafted here and all the expectations that were put on me and i think people want certain production so when that s not happening everybody s going to ask questions or figure out why is that the reason and so i wouldn t say i m surprised by anything that s talked about me anyway fortunately he still has 15 more games this season to prove them wrong

news_mentions.headline: Chargers QB Justin Herbert rejects leadership concerns: 'I trust those guys in that locker room'
news_mentions.description: When a team starts 0-2, it’s easy to blindly pin blame on the quarterback. That’s what’s happening in Los Angeles, where Justin Herbert's winless Chargers are fighting off talk of catastrophe and their leadership is being questioned.
news_mentions.body_text: when a team starts 0 2 it s easy to blindly pin blame on the quarterback that s what s happening in los angeles where the winless chargers are fighting off talk of catastrophe and their leadership is being questioned that specific query is what set off justin herbert on wednesday i think that happens regardless i think our team is so close and so i don t think there s a lack of vocal leadership at all an especially stern herbert said when asked if the team lacked a vocal leader so i think i m going to stop you right there and say that it s very present we ve got great leadership on this team i trust those guys in that locker room and so i don t think anyone is panicked or worried because that s not going to do us any good it s moving on to the next play and understanding we re close we ve made mistakes how do we fix them how do we move on mistakes have been plentiful for the chargers who have committed 15 accepted penalties for 109 yards and given away possession five times in two games those numbers don t account for the dropped passes either like the sharp throw from herbert that tight end david njoku bobbled into the hands of las vegas raiders cornerback hezekiah masses in week 2 simply the chargers have been an operational mess through two weeks herbert has had his positive moments but he too has made mistakes unnecessarily forcing passes in winnable games that have resulted in tide turning interceptions the upgraded offense that was supposed to come with the arrival of coordinator mike mcdaniel has failed to materialize and los angeles has scored just 28 points in two games i think anytime you learn a new offense um you re gonna have times where you re gonna just want to do your best and make sure that you re doing everything you can to be at your best herbert said so no i think every nfl offense is a complicated one but i think it s just on us to be studying our stuff making sure that we re ready to go the last line in herbert s response is intriguing if not illuminating the chargers have appeared anything but prepared to start this season getting outplayed and outcoached by an underdog arizona cardinals team that rolled into sofi stadium in week 1 and gleefully punched the bolts in the mouth the raiders enjoyed similar success in week 2 capitalizing on busted coverages poor discipline and even worse execution that made them look like the superior team too it s incredibly far from the standard coach jim harbaugh has set in los angeles since he arrived in 2024 and with the chargers schedule significantly increasing in difficulty starting in week 3 the pressure is on i think it s just about us being at our best learning and continuing to get better doing what we re coached to to be at our best herbert said they ll need to be at their peak sunday when they head to buffalo to face the red hot bills otherwise herbert will field more of the same frustrating questions again next week

news_mentions.headline: NFL Power Rankings, Week 3: Bengals, Chiefs climb; Bears, Buccaneers plummet
news_mentions.description: What do the Power Rankings look like after a wild week of football? How high do the Bengals fly after an inspiring road win? How low do the Buccaneers go after a humiliating home loss. Check out the full league hierarchy, 1-32, entering Week 3 of the 2026 NFL season.
news_mentions.body_text: week 2 reminds us that week 1 can be misleading week 2 also doubles the evidence available to us which can bring some early clarity to the power rankings then again when upsets get involved things get even more complicated the browns won the baker mayfield bowl over the buccaneers after a two hour weather delay the saints completed their second comeback effort of the season to take down a week 1 darling in baltimore and the rams five alarm fire wasn t so serious after all with two weeks in the books let s sort things out note up down arrows below reflect movement from the week 2 edition of the power rankings

news_mentions.headline: Cowboys defense hopes to stay 'disciplined' vs. Lamar Jackson after struggling with mobile QBs
news_mentions.description: The Cowboys head to Brazil this week to face Lamar Jackson and the Ravens in the NFL's first-ever game in Rio de Janeiro. The revamped Dallas D understands it has its hands full attempting to slow Jackson & Co.
news_mentions.body_text: the dallas cowboys head to brazil this week to face lamar jackson and the baltimore ravens in the nfl s first ever game in rio de janeiro the revamped dallas defense understands it has its hands full attempting to slow jackson and co we all know what it is cowboys pass rusher donovan ezeiruaku said via the team s official website you guys know we know as players the type of guy he is somebody who can throw the ball but also run the ball at a very high level it s easier to say than to do but our job is to go out there and go do that s what we re tasked with jackson leads the nfl with 10 0 pass yards per attempt through two weeks the qb hasn t run a ton 11 carries for 74 yards and a touchdown but has looked more spry when he has taken off than a year ago the cowboys must key on his scrambling ability after struggling to stop qb runs in the first two weeks against jaxson dart 11 54 and jayden daniels 7 69 the cowboys have allowed the most rushing yards to quarterbacks in the nfl 126 on 19 carries 6 6 ypc that figure would have been even worse had daniels not exited last sunday s game at halftime with an elbow injury dallas must make a more concerted effort to slow jackson just being disciplined cowboys defensive tackle kenny clark said communication just understanding our rush lanes playing with extension powering offensive linemen and just restricting those gaps so you can t get through but the main thing is just staying disciplined and communicating the ravens missing zay flowers due to a hamstring injury weren t as explosive in week 2 but the combination of jackson and derrick henry will always trouble defenses despite just five carries in the second half on sunday henry has 212 rush yards and four rush tds through two games he s tied for the nfl lead in tds and only kenneth walker 290 has more rush yards slowing both jackson and henry in the same game is a monumental task for any defense it is very unique ezeiruaku said for a guy who s probably bigger than me playing running back you ve got to take out the legs that s the only way to stop a guy like that from running the ball easier said than done like it is with lamar but it ll be a really good challenge on paper it s a rough matchup for dallas defense which through two games hasn t shown significant improvement from a year ago under christian parker too many mental mistakes remain there is a lack of pass rush and the tackling is mediocre dallas enters sunday s tilt ranked 32nd in third down percent allowed 68 30th in rush yards per game allowed 173 5 29th in yards per game allowed 391 5 29th in sacks 24th in yards per play allowed 5 8 18th in points per game 24 0 and 17th in pass yards per game 218

news_mentions.headline: NFL Week 2 Sunday aftermath: Surprising Raiders, soaring Chiefs and sinking Chargers in spotlight
news_mentions.description: How surprising is the Raiders' 2-0 start? Are Patrick Mahomes and the Chiefs truly BACK? Can anyone handle Brian Flores' blitz-happy defense? NFL.com senior news writer Kevin Patra digs into the top storylines coming out of Week 2 of the 2026 NFL season.
news_mentions.body_text: following the scoring splurge in week 1 defenses struck back on sunday the 13 afternoon games on sunday averaged 36 8 points boosted by the two prime time contests the league wide average of 40 9 points per tilt in week 2 is down significantly from week 1 s mark of 49 4 ppg with monday night football remaining five defenses held their opponents without a touchdown on sunday carolina chicago cincinnati minnesota and new england it s notable that two of those teams the bears and panthers were involved in a 96 point week 1 bout the week to week flip underscores that clubs are still figuring themselves out early in the 2026 campaign two high profile quarterback injuries jayden daniels dislocated left elbow and caleb williams hamstring will hover over the early portion of the week as we wait to better understand the extent of those players potential absences let s look at the rest of the aftermath of sunday s showdowns including chiefs prove they re back with ot victory vikings d dominates in gritty win at chicago cowboys get back on track as dak passes romo concern brewing for these four offenses one defender who stuffed the stat sheet in week 2 but first a look at some unexpected developments in the young season raiders lead surprising 2 0 teams if we were ranking the most stunning teams to begin this season at 2 0 we d start with the las vegas raiders then there would be a wide football field long gap before the next squad klint kubiak and co took care of business in the opener against a miami team they were supposed to beat they were expected to be a doormat in l a in week 2 nope instead the raiders sent the chargers spiraling with a 26 14 win outplaying their opponents in all three facets that isn t something we ve been able to say about the silver and black in a long long time it s not just that vegas won its first two games it s that the raiders are winning by being the more professional team in years past the raiders have bungled themselves into the turf they were the ones turning the ball over in key spots making mental mistakes and taking brutal drive killing penalties sunday they were the even keeled squad letting the chargers dunk on themselves vegas capitalized at every turn kirk cousins is far from perfect but the 38 year old can still sling it on throws of 10 plus air yards against the bolts cousins was 8 of 12 for 181 yards three touchdowns and one interception per nfl research the 40 yard touchdown pass to tre tucker was just the third completed pass of 40 plus air yards by a raiders qb over the past three seasons kubiak has modernized the offense while rob leonard s defense has swarmed forcing five turnovers over two games the raiders had 16 takeaways all of last year soberly i anticipate the positive vibes from the raiders first 2 0 start since 2021 to be curtailed particularly as the schedule picks up in october however the building blocks of the future are more visible than at any time in recent memory and that s without the no 1 overall pick fernando mendoza at the helm yet the bengals would probably rank as the next most surprising 2 0 squad not because of the record but because of how they ve won their games on the back of the defense as joe burrow got battered and the offense scuffled for much of sunday s contest in houston the defense kept giving c j stroud and the texans fits the run defense turnaround led by dexter lawrence and jonathan allen has completely flipped how the bengals can play a year ago they were getting gashed as the young linebackers struggled through two weeks with the big boys creating havoc and taking up blockers demetrius knight and barrett carter have played more fluidly sure the young lbs still have some coverage issues but their performance has improved significantly on sunday the bengals did not allow a single touchdown their first game allowing zero tds since a 27 12 road win over the jets back in week 3 of 2022 per nfl research of course there was still the joe burrow ja 39 marr chase magic to put cincy over the top but this was a game the bengals lose with last year s defense while we re here this is how i d rank the eight 2 0 teams with the giants looking to join the list by beating the rams on monday night starting with the most impressive through two weeks buffalo bills san francisco 49ers seattle seahawks kansas city chiefs minnesota vikings cincinnati bengals las vegas raiders philadelphia eagles chiefs mahomes prove they are back trailing the colts in the third quarter and facing a third and 11 patrick mahomes uncorked a 45 yard bomb to tyquan thornton to put the chiefs on the doorstep of a go ahead touchdown the heave underscored that a mahomes is fully back and b the chiefs offense can finally return to being a field stretching menace k c turned back the clock on sunday night with travis kelce looking spry and gobbling up 101 yards and mahomes dropping bombs in the ot win the qb threw for 382 passing yards and three tds while playing near flawless football the presence of kenneth walker has completely unlocked the chiefs offense the rb wasn t as dynamic on sunday night as he was in week 1 yet he still bulldozed his way for 117 yards on 24 carries the threat of walker however is a massive boon to mahomes it opens up the play action in a way the two time mvp hasn t had in the past against indy he recorded a career high 14 completions on play action passes per next gen stats across 17 play action attempts he totaled 137 yards and two touchdowns also after failing to complete a downfield pass in week 1 mahomes finished with six completions on nine downfield attempts 10 air yards for 154 yards after years of living in an offensive box and having to manufacture scores the hard way while leaning on the defense the chiefs attack finally looks like it inhaled fresh oxygen vikings dominant d here to stay boy the vikings can coach the early front runners for coach of the year and assistant coach of the year should both reside in minnesota kevin o connell has made the offense work without his starting quarterback and one of his top running backs starting in place of kyler murray carson wentz struggled in the rain soaked soldier field conditions but unlike in previous years wentz avoided the catastrophic turnover that might have sunk his team the far more impressive unit however belongs to brian flores the vikings defense has been the biggest game changer in a young season the ferocious d flipped the script on green bay in week 1 then smothered a bears team that had just put up 59 points keeping ben johnson s offense out of the end zone for 60 minutes in a 9 3 win flores blitzed caleb williams on 27 of his 33 dropbacks 81 8 before he exited the game in the fourth quarter that blitz rate would have ranked as the third highest mark in a game by a defense since at least 2018 per ngs flores ability to create havoc without confusing his own players or giving up a trove of big plays on the back end is impressive other teams could try it and get repeatedly burned for flores it s a style it s doubly remarkable given the questions minnesota entered the season with on the back end isaiah rodgers has been studly so far and the return of veteran safety harrison smith has been a godsend dallas turner has come on strong in year 3 the former first round pick generated 10 pressures including two sacks on 36 pass rushes against the bears marking his second straight week with double digit pressures per ngs five of the pressures on sunday were unblocked a credit to flores discombobulating the offense as minnesota s offense continues to figure things out flores defense has the muscle and guts to keep the vikes on the winning track boys back on track after dak s record day after the prime time week 1 dud in new york dallas showed its high octane potential in an easy home win over the commanders with dak prescott tossing four touchdown strikes to break tony romo s all time franchise record of 248 passing tds it s quite impressive for a former fourth rounder to put himself in a spot not only to break records but to sprint past them sometimes it s great being naive and i was a little naive just growing up thinking that i could do this and i could do that but yet i think it put such insurmountable belief in my head that i can accomplish whatever i want to accomplish prescott said after the game and any thought that i said or anything that i wanted to do and i mentioned it and i said it out loud i had a mom and i had brothers who poured gas on those thoughts who told me i could and as i said you can call it arrogance you can call it confidence belief whatever you need to i wouldn t be here if i didn t have those thoughts if i didn t believe in myself like that and i just encourage the next little kid out there who comes from the trailer park in louisiana or wherever he may come from and doesn t know if he can do it or have the resources or have the family that you re right believe in what you want to believe in and find the people that support that and you can do it the cowboys continue to have issues with their revamped defense under christian parker the injuries aren t helping but dallas had far too many breakdowns against washington especially early some of the issues are of the mental variety and can be cleaned up sunday was reminiscent of 2025 when the cowboys needed big offensive performances to earn ws fortunately for brian schottenheimer when dak spins it like he did against the commanders few defenses can keep him quiet the hope is that eventually the defense catches up are these four offenses in trouble week 2 sunday spotlight

news_mentions.headline: NFC East training camp 2026 preview: Top storylines for Commanders, Cowboys, Eagles, Giants
news_mentions.description: As we hurtle toward the 2026 NFL season, Grant Gordon breaks down the top NFC East training camp storylines to monitor for the Dallas Cowboys, New York Giants, Philadelphia Eagles and Washington Commanders.
news_mentions.body_text: with 2026 training camps just around the corner it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams grant gordon has the lowdown on the key position battles and top storylines to monitor for the dallas cowboys new york giants philadelphia eagles and washington commanders catch up on each nfc east team s offseason developments and 2026 outlook below dallas cowboys new york giants philadelphia eagles washington commanders three key storylines 1 summer bliss with pickens and no drama in oxnard aside from some contract squabbles with george pickens and brandon aubrey that were tame by cowboys standards this has been a drama free offseason for dallas will that change during training camp in oxnard california it s been a breath of fresh air that s even drawn applause from one of the greatest cowboys ever nfl all time leading rusher emmitt smith with dallas locked in on snapping a two year playoff drought the on field focus bodes well avoiding major storylines might well be the biggest development of the summer for the boys july 28 looms large for the team as it s when players are set to report to camp and owner jerry jones traditionally addresses the media in a lengthy news conference the cowboys have been transparent about not negotiating an extension with pickens who has signed his franchise tag and stated he doesn t intend to hold out we ll see just how copacetic everything remains when camp kicks off 2 downs arrives with plenty of hype ohio state safety caleb downs was viewed as a top line talent in this year s draft the cowboys getting him at no 11 overall was a major boon since joining the team downs has garnered rave reviews the highest defensive selection for the franchise since morris claiborne at no 6 in 2012 downs fills a massive db need for dallas and could prove to be a steal how he looks when the pads are on will be must see viewing for the fans at camp and a pivotal point in the cowboys defensive reconstruction downs isn t the cowboys only 2026 first round selection though picked 23rd overall malachi lawrence is a pass rusher who some felt went earlier than he should ve he has plenty of upside though and the cowboys have plenty of pass rushing needs to fill after mustering just 35 sacks in 2025 tied for 22nd in the league 3 a whole new world on defense dallas defense was a sieve in 2025 finishing dead last in points allowed and 30th in total d perhaps it wasn t too surprising considering the cowboys traded away micah parsons just before the season arrived nonetheless the disastrous results led to matt eberflus ousting young whippersnapper christian parker has taken over as defensive coordinator and garnered plenty of positive buzz he ll helm a defense that has undergone a colossal facelift in the offseason in addition to a pair of first rounders added to the mix dallas has signed safeties jalen thompson and p j locke along with cornerback cobie durant whilst trading for pass rusher rashan gary and linebacker dee winters dallas also has a full season ahead with pro bowler quinnen williams after he too was acquired via trade last season 2025 third round corner shavon revel played just seven games as a rookie rallying from an acl tear in college with downs likely to start from the get go lawrence and a host of other defensive draft picks have replenished the depth the turnover on this side of the ball is staggering but a fresh coat was needed after such a trying 2025 how the finished product ultimately looks will begin to take shape at camp for as ballyhooed as the dak prescott led offense has been the cowboys 2021 23 run of playoff appearances came with an offense and a defense ranked in the top seven in scoring back to top three key storylines 1 can giants get healthy stay healthy in camp harbaugh john harbaugh after 18 years with the ravens has arrived in gotham with plenty of fanfare but his team has already dealt with an alarming amount of injury exits rookie cornerback thaddeus dixon wide receiver special teamer gunner olszewski and defensive lineman roy robertson harris each stunningly suffered a torn achilles during organized team activities robertson harris injury is especially problematic considering the team traded away standout defensive tackle dexter lawrence abdul carter sprained his ankle in june while top receivers malik nabers knee and darius slayton core muscle surgery and second year running back cam skattebo ankle are on the mend as well monitoring the availability of nabers and skattebo for week 1 will carry on through the summer even though the latter has deemed himself a sure bet for the opener with harbaugh reputed to run tough practices the giants healing up and emerging unscathed is paramount 2 this is dart s team now at the start of last season jaxson dart waited his turn behind russell wilson after eventually getting handed the starting reins the first round pick weathered a debut campaign that saw him deal with injuries scrutiny for his devil may care scrambling and the firing of head coach brian daboll daboll and interim head coach mike kafka took turns navigating dart s first season now it s up to matt nagy to shepherd dart s growth the floor for dart is staying healthy the ceiling is what the big blue faithful are most excited about dart s development as a franchise signal caller is arguably the most important factor for the 2026 giants hype and hope have early expiration dates in the nfl so dart s second season is already a pivotal one after the qb showed plenty of potential 24 total touchdowns in his career opening campaign 3 big blue youth movement taking shape over the past two drafts the giants have stockpiled four first round picks carter dart lb arvell reese and ol francis mauigoa rookie wr malachi fields and first year cb colton hood a pair of day 2 picks in april figure to be big contributors though there is sterling veteran talent such as lt andrew thomas and olb brian burns the giants are a young squad looking to lay a winning foundation in the first year under harbaugh high draft spots and hype can provide anticipation but seeing the youngsters round into form this summer will be crucial for 2026 and beyond back to top three key storylines 1 hurts newest offensive scheme sean mannion is the latest offensive coordinator for the eagles and jalen hurts who truly found offensive bliss in 2022 his second and final season with shane steichen since then hurts has had a different offensive coordinator in each season even with kellen moore during a super bowl winning 2024 campaign philadelphia s passing game ebbed and flowed while running back saquon barkley largely fueled the offense drama was more prevalent last season than offensive chemistry as the passing game ranked 23rd in yards and the sputtering running attack diminished from the previous season s dominance hurts had a career best 25 touchdown passes but snapped a four season streak of double digit rushing scores finishing with eight last year s offense was far too predictable and stagnated on a seemingly weekly basis held to 20 points or less in 10 games including a dismal 23 19 playoff loss to the 49ers with o line guru jeff stoutland no longer coaching a group that was really the heartbeat of both of the eagles super bowl squads under nick sirianni the offense is undergoing more change than the annual alterations everyone s accustomed to a j brown is gone traded to the patriots in an offseason storyline that lingered for months all eyes are on hurts whose past accomplishments don t seem to hold too much weight with a feisty fanbase that believes its strong roster should be vying for lombardi trophies every year 2 new look wide receivers after four seasons two super bowl appearances and one lombardi trophy a j brown has departed philadelphia while brown s disharmony commanded the headlines he topped 1 000 yards receiving in each of his four years with the team devonta smith is now the unquestioned top target but gm howie roseman restocked the wr room with a trade for dontayvion wicks the signing of veteran speedster marquise brown and in the most exciting move the first round selection of makai lemon don t sleep on second round tight end eli stowers either the john mackey award winner from vanderbilt could line up all over the field as a 6 foot 4 matchup nightmare dallas goedert is back likely for one final season and smith one of the more underrated wideouts around adds to the familiarity overall though there is a freshness to the group that will need to come together in the summer but could liven up an all too often static offense from a season ago 3 what becomes of carter jalen carter seems to be on the brink of becoming perhaps the league s elite defensive tackle hence he s seeking a seismic extension which has led to trade speculation how it all plays out is sure to be headline fodder and it wouldn t feel right to be without some melodrama in philly furthermore defensive coordinator vic fangio is back and losing carter would be a magnificent blow a potential boon will be the additions of cornerback tariq woolen and pass rusher jonathan greenard no matter the pedigree not all players fit into fangio s scheme see bryce huff jalen ramsey jevon holland etc woolen is a physically gifted cover man who made his share of questionable plays with the seahawks it will be interesting seeing how the newbies fit into fangio s scheme but the prevailing matter at hand for the defense is carter s future back to top three key storylines 1 plenty on daniels plate there s a lot to accomplish for jayden daniels this summer following a disastrous 2025 season the commanders sputtered and the 2024 ap offensive rookie of the year missed 10 games due to injuries going just 2 5 in the games he played how daniels looks and feels after sustaining a sprained knee strained hamstring and dislocated left elbow is tops on the agenda he also needs to get acclimated to david blough s offense which will see daniels taking snaps under center far more now that his former assistant qb coach is his offensive coordinator after two seasons with kliff kingsbury in that role daniels is also in the latest season of netflix s quarterback series all eyes and a heap of responsibility will be on daniels how he bounces back and how well he adapts to a new offense could be the story of the commanders season 2 how does overhauled defense look when you fall from being everyone s nfc championship game darling to a 5 12 struggle bus you can run out of fingers to point the commanders put a massive under construction sign in front of a defense that finished dead last in yards allowed they used the no 7 overall pick on ohio state linebacker sonny styles an athletic marvel who will draw plenty of hype as a preseason defensive rookie of the year candidate general manager adam peters opened the check book before turning in the card to get styles too washington broke the bank to sign pass rusher odafe oweh while adding plenty more veteran starters elsewhere nickel amik robertson safety nick cross pass rusher k 39 lavon chaisson linebacker leo chenal and defensive tackle tim settle the commanders added veteran depth as well binging on free agents isn t always a winning formula of course how quickly new defensive coordinator daronte jones and washington s cast of fresh faces get on the same page will be crucial in camp 3 all set at skill spots daniels injuries were a giant issue in 2025 but not surrounding the blossoming franchise qb with enough talent at the skill spots also loomed large looking at the offensive roster on paper it s difficult to feel the commanders have remedied those ills terry mclaurin who dealt with a contract kerfuffle last year as well as ankle quad and pelvic injuries will hopefully be back to his pro bowl self with a full camp and good health however the team s wr corps hasn t added much to get overjoyed about dyami brown and van jefferson were signed in free agency while treylon burks and luke mccaffrey are both back none of those four reached 30 receptions or 400 yards in 2025 rookie third rounder antonio williams figures to jump right into the mix and will likely need to be a big contributor quickly elsewhere jacory croskey merritt should be the lead back after an 805 yard rookie campaign but he was hardly a consistent producer in year 1 the most notable additions are former titans tight end chigoziem okonkwo who should be a breakout candidate after three straight 50 catch seasons with tennessee and ex buccaneers running back rachaad white with blough s promotion to oc familiarity remains but this offensive roster is certainly a candidate for a veteran add or two in the weeks before the regular season commences back to top

material_news_signals.headline: NFL QB rankings, Week 3: Patrick Mahomes, Dak Prescott, Matthew Stafford heating up
material_news_signals.description: Thirty passers are on the move in Nick Shook's QB rankings, with Dak Prescott entering the top five. Check out the updated pecking order, 1-32, heading into Week 3 of the 2026 NFL season.
material_news_signals.body_text: notes up down arrows illustrate movement from the week 2 qb index stream live local and prime time games on mobile with nfl tier 1 josh allen can do no wrong following up a four touchdown season debut with a five touchdown showing in week 2 he has an early lead in the mvp race patrick mahomes has proven he s completely back from the knee injury that ended his 2025 season he fired majestic strikes and moved with the full capability that has defined his brand in the win over the colts the fact he s operating in an offense that now has a legitimate running game is an added bonus next gen stats insight via nfl pro mahomes completed 8 of 9 passes for 133 yards and two tds against man coverage in week 1 a contrast to a 2025 campaign in which his 5 0 yards per attempt against man were the second fewest in the nfl and his five ints were tied for second most brock purdy is another early mvp candidate after lighting up the rams and dolphins to start the season posting a league best completion percentage of 80 4 dak prescott got back on track in week 2 dropping an absurd amount of gorgeous dimes on ceedee lamb in a 37 20 romp over washington and reminding the football world of his elite talents yes i called him elite and i m not exaggerating matthew stafford returned to form after looking rusty in his 2026 debut torching the giants by leaning heavily on davante adams jared goff was excellent in the second half of detroit s week 2 loss a reality that will be lost on most who only check final scores for the lions sake hopefully his efforts will produce more wins going forward next gen stats insight via nfl pro goff has the most games with 2 passing touchdowns and zero interceptions in the nfl since the start of 2024 18 2023 25 2022 31 and 2021 35 the year he was traded to the lions tier 2 the bengals were a bit uneven offensively against houston s top tier defense but they won with big plays made possible by joe burrow s arm talent decision making and willingness to let it rip while under duress he and the bengals haven t been consistently explosive through two weeks but burrow deserves credit for going into houston and leading cincinnati to a 14 point win next gen stats insight via nfl pro burrow completed all three of his deep passes 20 air yards to ja marr chase for 73 yards and two tds in week 2 against the texans it was jarring to watch baltimore s offense lose its juice once derrick henry disappeared from the game plan in week 2 and it didn t reflect well on lamar jackson yes he didn t have wr1 zay flowers available but jackson s inability to overcome a surprising change in defensive strategy new orleans decreased its blitz rate in the second half and improved and his game sealing interception dealt a blow to his sparkling reputation for at least one week next gen stats insight via nfl pro jackson used play action on 34 2 of dropbacks against the saints completing 6 of his 10 play action attempts for 101 yards bryce young stacked another excellent showing on top of his season debut making throws that wowed viewers and buoyed his standing in the qb index the confidence and conviction represents a significant step forward for a quarterback who needs a career year ahead of contract talks trevor lawrence was incredibly sharp early in denver fitting passes into tight windows and pushing the jaguars offense forward his dropoff in the second half was disappointing though and contributed directly to jacksonville s defeat tier 3 tyler shough has an obvious clutch gene and unchecked bravery that has already propelled two second half comebacks this season and powered the saints to one of the biggest upsets of week 2 it sure helps that chris olave is blossoming a product of a symbiotic relationship between quarterback and receiver next gen stats insight via nfl pro shough completed 10 of his 13 attempts against the blitz for 113 yards a career high mark while also going 17 for 21 for 139 yards and a touchdown when facing four or fewer rushers drew lock lit up arizona in his first start in place of the injured sam darnold throwing without fear and reaping the benefits he steadied the seahawks offense in a situation that could have taken a downward turn with a lesser quarterback next gen stats insight via nfl pro lock completed 7 of 11 downfield pass attempts 10 air yards for 175 yards in week 2 against the cardinals the second most of his career along with two touchdowns jalen hurts tossed a couple of interceptions against the titans but he also pushed the eagles to victory with his late game heroics with a j brown no longer in the mix in philly hurts rapport with devonta smith is among the most enjoyable developments of the early portion of 2026 c j stroud has played well at times in the first two weeks but he hasn t yet strung together a complete performance next gen stats insight via nfl pro through two weeks stroud leads the league in dropbacks 104 and pass attempts 93 only 10 8 of his pass attempts have been thrown at or behind the line of scrimmage the second lowest rate in the league jayden daniels played really well in the first half of washington s week 2 loss and likely would have kept the game close to the very end had he not suffered a dislocated left elbow on the final play of the second quarter it s a massively disappointing development for both the commanders and fans of electrifying quarterback play brian flores vikings defense got after caleb williams whose fast and loose playing style burned him when he attempted an off balance throw on the run that resulted in an interception williams still had his moments but he couldn t overcome the elements or minnesota s aggression and his hamstring injury was an awful way to end his day we ll all hope williams can return near full strength before long because he s so fun to watch tier 4 jordan love was thrown into the rain at metlife stadium in week 2 and unsurprisingly he struggled he did manage to lead a comeback victory with an offense that lacks any semblance of a running game though he ll need to improve before long or else he ll continue to hover around the dalton line daniel jones did his best to keep the colts in a thrilling sunday night contest and nearly threw them to victory next gen stats insight via nfl pro jones used play action on 51 5 of his dropbacks vs the chiefs his second highest rate in a game in his career and was effective when doing so completing 14 of his 16 attempts for 159 yards and a touchdown his second most yards on play action passes in a game in his career kirk cousins has been tremendously fun to watch especially for fans of grizzled veterans who might be getting their final chance to play meaningful football before father time arrives cousins play against the chargers was heroic at times and he s done a great job of quieting the conversation regarding rookie fernando mendoza s eventual rise to the top job next gen stats insight via nfl pro cousins joined tom brady 2021 2015 and peyton manning 2014 as the only quarterbacks age 38 or older with at least three touchdown passes in each of his team s first two games of a season drake maye played better against the steelers than the 20 3 final score suggested but the patriots have a problem with finishing drives maye still isn t close to the elite quarterback he was in 2025 tier 5 justin herbert isn t the main reason the chargers are 0 2 he s made plenty of excellent throws but he also isn t helping los angeles in key moments when taking unnecessary risks that result in turnovers next gen stats insight via nfl pro herbert has gone 0 for 7 with two ints on tight window throws this season less than one yard of separation while attempting those throws at a 13 0 clip a mark just below the nfl average 14 3 geno smith s solid start carried over into week 2 for a portion of the contest but the weather didn t help his efforts in a disappointing loss bo nix and the broncos still have a problem with starting slowly and nix continues to vacillate between a quarterback who can make incredible throws and commit maddening mistakes next gen stats insight via nfl pro nix completed 16 of 17 passes against four or fewer rushers for 205 yards and a td in week 2 against the jaguars tied for the second highest completion percentage when not facing the blitz by any quarterback since the start of last season min 10 attempts jaxson dart s encouraging start to 2026 was interrupted by a knee injury that wiped out the rest of his season throwing the giants into a depressing and familiar scenario from which they thought they d graduated tier 6 cam ward and the titans were much better offensively in week 2 they gave the eagles a four quarter battle most didn t expect to see ward appears to be gaining confidence in brian daboll s offense and has regained some of his playmaking ability that drove optimism after his rookie season although there s still plenty of room to grow it was nice to see deshaun watson produce competent play on a sunday it wasn t great by any means nor was it pretty but watson keyed a second half comeback that saw the browns outscore the buccaneers 17 3 to finish the game including a 55 yard catch and run touchdown for rookie denzel boston his second in as many weeks and a third down completion to tight end blake whiteheart for the game winning score that s exponentially better than anything i ve written about watson in about two years which is worthy of a bump next gen stats insight via nfl pro watson is the first starting qb to lead a fourth quarter comeback to snap a 6 game personal losing streak since justin fields 2025 jacoby brissett played better against the seahawks than his stat line suggested in the first half by leaning heavily on trey mcbride for two quarters it appeared as if brissett might go toe to toe with drew lock that optimism faded in a lopsided second half in which brissett couldn t overcome the suffocating seattle defense next gen stats insight via nfl pro brissett was under pressure on 41 9 of dropbacks in week 2 against the seahawks completing 4 of 11 passes for 9 yards with an int under pressure and 13 of 17 for 86 yards and a td from a clean pocket we have real reason to be concerned about tampa bay s offense a scheme in which baker mayfield simply appears uncomfortable and uncertain i m not sure there s a quick fix to this issue either a frantic skittish mayfield isn t going to be capable of overcoming an offense that lacks identity rhythm and confidence tier 7 malik willis is trying his best to lead an offense that simply doesn t take care of the details and carries one of the lowest ceilings in the nfl it s not necessarily his fault but it s clear he s not quite the quarterback who can carry an undermanned team to victory at this stage in his career aaron rodgers age was painfully obvious in new england on sunday his offensive line struggled to protect him his receivers didn t help him and he didn t look like he enjoyed his job very much somehow an offense with more freedom to be aggressive has produced worse results and at 42 years old it looks like rodgers isn t capable of overcoming these challenges right now next gen stats insight via nfl pro rodgers finished with 187 passing yards 0 touchdowns and 1 int his fifth straight start with one passing td or fewer tied for the second longest such streak of his career carson wentz s performance was entirely forgettable in a rainy 9 3 victory in chicago we ll see if kyler murray s return can get the offense back on track cooper rush has been the worst quarterback in the nfl through two weeks but thankfully michael penix is returning to the lineup this week we ll see if his style of play fits better than that of rush who wasn t helped much by an underperforming offensive line

news_mentions.headline: J.J. McCarthy, Mac Jones, Jimmy Garoppolo and 4 other QBs who could help teams in need
news_mentions.body_text: the nfl season is only two weeks old and yet six teams have already dealt with injuries to their starting quarterbacks the falcons were already without michael penix because of his recovery from an acl injury when tua tagovailoa went down with a back injury just days before the opener in week 1 the seahawks lost sam darnold to a glute injury and vikings starter kyler murray suffered a concussion week 2 was even worse the commanders lost jayden daniels to another dislocated elbow the same one he dislocated last season the bears watched caleb williams get carted off with a hamstring injury and then placed backup tyler bagent in the concussion protocol and the giants saw jaxson dart go down with a knee injury that is expected to end his season the spate of early injuries to quarterbacks has reinforced the value of experienced and reliable backups the teams that have them have remained competitive seattle and minnesota are both 2 0 with respective backups drew lock and carson wentz filling in but the teams that lack a solid no 2 or any real depth at the position have paid a price just look at atlanta where third stringer cooper rush was benched during a blowout loss to the panthers after throwing his fourth pick of the season he was replaced by jack strand who promptly threw a pick six there 39 s good news in store for a few teams penix will start for the falcons on thursday night and tagovailoa is back to fully participating in practice darnold is expected to return to practice in some capacity this week for the seahawks and murray has been cleared from the concussion protocol in minnesota but that leaves three teams who could be in search of reinforcement case keenum is the only other quarterback on the bears 39 active roster and although he has 66 starts in his 14 year nfl career he hasn 39 t played a regular season snap since december 2023 for washington it remains unclear how much time daniels might miss x rays of daniels 39 elbow were negative for any fractures but coach dan quinn declined to provide any details about the mri results daniels will not start sunday against the seahawks but how long he 39 ll be out thereafter is unknown in the meantime the commanders will turn to marcus mariota just as they have the past two seasons when daniels has dealt with injuries the difference this time around washington doesn 39 t have an experienced third string qb like it had with josh johnson last year the team 39 s current no 3 is seventh round rookie athan kaliakmanis a young player who showed some promise in the preseason but is still quite green the giants are in an even trickier position dart 39 s prognosis is much worse than what was originally expected jameis winston is expected to take over as the starter but he 39 s the only other quarterback on the giants 39 active roster jake haener a fourth round pick by the saints in 2023 is on the practice squad so who might be available to help finding a quality backup quarterback at this point in the season is difficult but there are several veterans and young qbs who could serve as extra insurance if not more for teams in need from potential trade candidates to street free agents and practice squad players here are some players who may be under consideration either now or after the next prominent starter goes down mac jones the sixth year quarterback has seemingly found his groove with san francisco as brock purdy 39 s backup after a standout rookie season with the patriots in which he was named a pro bowl alternate jones cycled through multiple play callers and quickly regressed he was traded to jacksonville in 2024 and started seven games in relief of trevor lawrence but it wasn 39 t until he signed a two year deal with the 49ers in 2025 that he really showed his worth as a reliable backup he went 5 3 as a fill in starter recording a 69 6 completion percentage averaging 7 4 yards per attempt and compiling a 97 4 passer rating all career bests san francisco may want to hold on to him to spell purdy but it could also get a decent return from a desperate team for a player who is set to be a free agent after this season jimmy garoppolo the 12 year veteran and two time super bowl winner reportedly considered retirement in the offseason but ultimately decided to keep his options open in the nfl as a free agent garoppolo 34 nbsp hasn 39 t had any real playing time since the 2024 season when he started the rams 39 regular season finale against the seahawks and he hasn 39 t had any consistent playing time since the start of the 2023 season with the raiders but he does have a 43 21 record as a starter to go with a 67 4 career completion percentage and 97 6 passer rating josh johnson johnson 40 is in his 19th season of professional football and is still going as a member of the bengals 39 practice squad he is the ultimate journeyman playing for a record 14 nfl teams johnson was washington 39 s third string quarterback last season until daniels went down and he became the backup and then the starter late in the season when mariota suffered a quad injury his familiarity with offensive coordinator david blough and washington 39 s other quarterbacks could make him a viable option if the commanders seek outside reinforcement but johnson also has deep ties to giants coach john harbaugh and his brother chargers coach jim johnson had three stints with the ravens when harbaugh was their coach totaling seven games one start and completing 69 8 percent of his passes for 321 passing yards two tds a pick and a 97 1 passer rating will levis levis signed to the jets 39 practice squad tuesday so should the giants be interested in adding him to their active roster he 39 d have a pretty easy move but would they the 2023 second round pick by the titans showed some promise when he took over for ryan tannehill as a rookie but injuries and poor performances derailed his tenure in tennessee he was benched late in the 2024 season when giants quarterbacks coach brian callahan was tennessee 39 s head coach levis missed all of 2025 because of a shoulder injury and was released last month after losing the backup job to mitchell trubisky anthony richardson richardson never developed into the franchise quarterback the colts hoped he 39 d be when they drafted him with the fourth pick in 2023 injuries performance issues and general readiness questions after he tapped out for a play during a narrow loss to the texans in 2024 put him on the outs with the organization he lost his starting job to daniel jones requested a trade and is now in the final year of his rookie contract the colts declined his fifth year option if richardson is viewed as more of a developmental project then a team in need of immediate help may be unlikely to trade for him but never say never j j mccarthy the same context holds for mccarthy the vikings 39 2024 first round pick mccarthy missed the entirety of his rookie season because of a torn meniscus and was sidelined for seven games last season because of injuries mccarthy fell to third string this season after the team signed murray to start and re signed wentz as his backup mccarthy has started only 10 games and has more interceptions 12 than touchdowns 11 but he 39 s well liked in the harbaugh family jim harbaugh once lauded mccarthy as the greatest quarterback in michigan history brandon allen the 10 year veteran has spent more than four seasons with callahan three in cincinnati when callahan was the bengals 39 offensive coordinator another in tennessee when callahan was head coach and this offseason with the giants allen was among the roster cuts late last month this article originally appeared in the athletic

news_mentions.headline: Falcons vs. Packers: Three must-know storylines for Thursday's Week 3 prime-time game
news_mentions.description: Can the Packers put a sloppy start behind them? Will Michael Penix Jr.'s 2026 debut spark the Falcons' offense? In advance of Thursday's game between Atlanta and Green Bay, Dan Parr provides three storylines you need to know.
news_mentions.body_text: thursday night s battle features two teams yearning for a spark to break out of early season doldrums the packers are playing at home for the first time in 2026 after narrowly avoiding an 0 2 start with a comeback win over the jets in overtime meanwhile the 0 2 falcons are still searching for some positive vibes after being trounced in their home opener by the panthers 34 3 green bay has a chance to make history on thursday with a win the packers will break the nfl record for consecutive victories in home openers currently tied at 13 with the 1976 1988 miami dolphins the falcons have dropped four straight at lambeau field with their last win in titletown coming back when the team s current president of football matt ryan was a rookie quarterback 2008 yes we re still early in the season but as far as week 3 games go the stakes couldn t be much higher for either club three must know storylines 1 can the packers clean it up it s been an uncharacteristically sloppy start for a team with postseason aspirations after making the playoffs in six of the past seven seasons matt lafleur s crew leads the league in penalties and penalty yards it ranks last in rushing yards also jordan love has the lowest completion rate of any quarterback with at least 30 pass attempts 52 1 the only qb over the last 10 seasons with a lower rate in his first two games of a season min 70 attempts was trevor lawrence in the first two games of his career 50 2021 per nfl research yikes obviously the packers have been playing shorthanded without edge terror micah parsons pup list and bell cow back josh jacobs commissioner s exempt list but that doesn t excuse the penalty issues green bay s not getting any better news on the injury front either after losing starting right tackle zach bako bewele torn patellar tendon for the season and wideout jayden reed to a back ailment in the win over the jets maybe the packers are catching the right opponent at the right time the falcons have their own health woes with cb1 a j terrell groin joining an ever growing list of starting defensive players on the sideline there s no way to fix everything with a short week to prepare but playing a cleaner game with love completing 60 plus percent of his throws would be a sign of progress for green bay 2 is michael penix the hero the falcons need penix is set to make his 2026 debut on thursday marking his first game back since tearing his left acl last november it s a very welcome development for a team that averaged a league low eight points and failed to reach the red zone with journeyman cooper rush starting the first two contests penix was cleared for full participation in practice about a month ago so he s had time to gear up for his return to game action it s a huge season for the eighth overall pick of the 2024 nfl draft with atlanta s new brass facing a decision on whether to exercise the fifth year option in his rookie deal next spring he compiled a record of just 4 8 as a starter in his first two seasons completing less than 60 percent of his passes and throwing for fewer than 200 yards per game thursday will give penix a chance to begin rewriting the narrative around his career and the packers are only one game removed from giving up 39 points to a vikings offense that no one is confusing for a juggernaut penix might want to avoid falling into his habit of holding on to the ball for too long though going against the team with the third highest pressure rate in the league 45 6 atlanta certainly has stockpiled an enviable collection of weapons at the skill positions with rb bijan robinson wr drake london and te kyle pitts all capable of performing at an all pro level which leads me to my next point 3 will the falcons utilize their pass catchers atlanta s wide receivers and tight ends have combined for 17 catches 173 receiving yards and zero touchdowns in 2026 all the fewest among the league s wr te units through week 2 the aforementioned pitts has only one catch for 15 yards and he s been targeted just four times that s a problem atlanta offensive coordinator tommy rees acknowledged this week telling reporters he has to do a better job of showcasing pitts who signed a contract extension this offseason that made him one of the highest paid tight ends in the league perhaps the quarterback change will help in that regard but pitts has just two touchdown catches in the 12 games penix has started penix has the arm strength to give the offense the downfield passing game it lacked in the first couple weeks now it s up to the coaching staff to exploit a packers defense that ranks 28th in red zone td percentage allowed 85 7
