news_mentions.headline: Can Falcons finally get TE Kyle Pitts going on 'Thursday Night Football' vs. Packers?
news_mentions.body_text: flowery branch ga through the first two weeks of the season kyle pitts and austin hooper of the atlanta falcons are tied for 34th among nfl tight ends in passing targets with four each this was not the plan 34 we have to get it going 34 offensive coordinator tommy rees said 34 that 39 s my job 34 pitts was the no 4 pick in the 2021 draft and the falcons signed him to a three year 54 million contract extension this offseason hooper is in his 11th season and signed a one year 3 25 million free agent deal in the offseason but it 39 s pitts who has felt like a bit player in the offense thus far he has one catch for 15 yards headed into thursday night 39 s game against the green bay packers fifty seven tight ends already have more receptions 34 i know the production hasn 39 t been there for him 34 head coach kevin stefanski said 34 but that 39 s not indicative of what we have planned for kyle 34 stefanski has called himself an 34 aficionado 34 of the tight end position but it would be fair to question that fondness at this point 34 we do love tight ends and kyle does fit that mold 34 rees said 34 getting him going is something that is important to us kyle has done nothing but work his tail off and be in the right spots i have to do a better job of making sure his talent is coming to the forefront we take a lot of ownership of that as a staff 34 pitts has only played half of the falcons 39 offensive snaps this year but that usage rate is misleading stefanski said because atlanta pulled its starters early in week 2 the packers might not be the best team against which to get pitts going they are 10th in the league in passing epa allowed on throws to tight ends minus 0 10 which is three times better than their passing epa against wide receivers and running backs according to trumedia 34 it 39 s a long season it would be selfish to get upset 34 pitts said this week 34 obviously i want to do as much as i can to contribute to this offense but it 39 s a long season and we 39 ll get it on track 34 here are a few more lingering questions heading into thursday 39 s game at lambeau field can c j henderson step up with cornerback a j terrell on the injured reserve list and out at least four games c j henderson has a chance that he 39 s been waiting for for a while even if it didn 39 t come the way he 39 d hoped 34 i just want to capitalize on it 34 henderson said 34 i haven 39 t played much ball the last few years so i want to capitalize and let people know i belong in this league 34 henderson and terrell were both first round draft picks in 2020 with henderson going ninth to the jacksonville jaguars and terrell being picked seven spots later by the falcons while terrell has gone on to start 95 games for atlanta henderson has bounced from the jaguars to the carolina panthers and briefly the houston texans and the pittsburgh steelers before landing with the falcons he hasn 39 t been a regular starter since 2023 in carolina but he believes he still has that ability he said this week falcons defensive coordinator jeff ulbrich agreed 34 it is rare in this league to have a backup corner like that 34 ulbrich said 34 a j in my opinion is the best boundary cornerback in the nfl whenever he has to step out normally that would be like 39 my goodness i gotta protect that backup i gotta get the safety over the top i got to do whatever they 39 re gonna go after him 39 i don 39 t feel any angst when c j goes in the game he goes out and every time he 39 s called upon he steps up and answers the bell 34 henderson has 34 career starts including two last year in atlanta there 39 s also a chance nickel corner avieon terrell could play more outside snaps with his older brother out of the lineup stefanski said wednesday is a short week good or bad for a falcons team coming off an embarrassing loss to the panthers it 39 s probably a good thing particularly with stefanski in charge atlanta 39 s first year head coach is 5 0 in thursday night games in his career 34 it definitely helps that it 39 s a short week 34 falcons safety xavier watts said 34 you have to shift your mind you can 39 t linger on last week at all there 39 s no panic whatsoever there is still a lot of time to go 34 is tua tagovailoa the backup this week michael penix might not be the only quarterback back in action this week tagovailoa returned to practice tuesday for the first time since injuring an oblique muscle three days before he was scheduled to start for atlanta in week 1 34 he 39 s trending in the right direction 34 to serve as penix 39 s backup against the packers stefanski said wednesday 34 he 39 s been an awesome teammate 34 stefanski said 34 he 39 s working very very hard to get himself back ultra supportive he 39 s a great guy to have around the building 34 can nick folk regain his form the falcons are not worried about kicker nick folk yet special teams coordinator craig aukerman said against carolina folk missed his third field goal attempt of the season that 39 s the same number of kicks he missed total in the three seasons before signing with atlanta in the offseason 34 our biggest thing is to focus in on his technique continue to hone that in 34 aukerman said 34 this guy has done it a long time in the nfl and he 39 s been consistent the last couple of years we have to get him back in rhythm 34 no team in the league has lost more points to missed kicks than the falcons in the last five seasons 101 according to trumedia folk has missed from 54 53 and 45 yards this season can the defense bounce back ulbrich attributed atlanta 39 s defensive struggles against the panthers to players blowing assignments because they were trying to make big plays as the falcons offense struggled carolina averaged 5 7 yards per play in week 2 34 there were some examples of some veteran guys that we trust implicitly making some very uncharacteristic mistakes we have to play better that is not even close to our standard 34 ulbrich said 34 it comes from the best of places but it 39 s a learning experience when we are struggling as a team like that there is the sense that players have to do more than their job and it led to some breakdowns some failures some explosive plays 34 the packers are 13th in the league in yards per play 5 3 through two weeks but 30th in offensive epa minus 19 08 extra points 8226 the packers have allowed the fourth highest quarterback pressure percentage 43 5 in the league this season while the falcons have the third best pressure rate 43 4 through two weeks 8226 under first year defensive coordinator jonathan gannon the packers have shown a lot of variance in their game plans leaving atlanta expecting to face defensive looks it has not specifically prepared for 34 it looks like two different groups out there in the first two weeks 34 rees said 8226 green bay 39 s skyy moore leads the league in punt return average 18 2 8226 the falcons do plan to try to mess with packers rookie kicker trey smack 34 i am sure our players will say hello to him at some point in the game 34 aukerman said 8226 the falcons are 23rd in the league in rushing success rate 33 3 percent 34 with our offensive production period it 39 s just not good enough 34 stefanski said 34 i am very very confident in the group we have to put a plan together and be successful in the run game 34 this article originally appeared in the athletic

news_mentions.headline: Ranking NFL's 0-2 teams: Why Texans, Buccaneers, Colts still have playoff hopes entering Week 3
news_mentions.description: Which of the league's eight 0-2 teams still have playoff hopes? NFL.com's Kevin Patra ranks this year's set of winless squads entering a pivotal Week 3.
news_mentions.body_text: it s never good to start your season 0 2 it s not a death knell either a year ago three of the 10 teams that started the season 0 2 made their way to the postseason the chicago bears houston texans and carolina panthers it marked the second straight season three clubs started 0 2 and made the playoffs thank you expanded playoff 17 games and pervasive parity since 1990 only 38 of 288 0 2 clubs 12 8 made the postseason 21 won a division title 7 and three took home a lombardi trophy 1 1993 dallas cowboys after emmitt smith ended his holdout 2001 new england patriots tom brady made his first career start in week 3 2007 new york giants who won their next six games and became the first nfc wild card team to win a super bowl the texans find themselves on this list for the second straight season needing to dig themselves out of an early season hole that provides little room for further missteps given their experience and tough opening slate demeco ryans squad leads my yearly ranking of 0 2 teams i still believe in

news_mentions.headline: NFL QB rankings, Week 3: Patrick Mahomes, Dak Prescott, Matthew Stafford heating up
news_mentions.description: Thirty passers are on the move in Nick Shook's QB rankings, with Dak Prescott entering the top five. Check out the updated pecking order, 1-32, heading into Week 3 of the 2026 NFL season.
news_mentions.body_text: notes up down arrows illustrate movement from the week 2 qb index stream live local and prime time games on mobile with nfl tier 1 josh allen can do no wrong following up a four touchdown season debut with a five touchdown showing in week 2 he has an early lead in the mvp race patrick mahomes has proven he s completely back from the knee injury that ended his 2025 season he fired majestic strikes and moved with the full capability that has defined his brand in the win over the colts the fact he s operating in an offense that now has a legitimate running game is an added bonus next gen stats insight via nfl pro mahomes completed 8 of 9 passes for 133 yards and two tds against man coverage in week 1 a contrast to a 2025 campaign in which his 5 0 yards per attempt against man were the second fewest in the nfl and his five ints were tied for second most brock purdy is another early mvp candidate after lighting up the rams and dolphins to start the season posting a league best completion percentage of 80 4 dak prescott got back on track in week 2 dropping an absurd amount of gorgeous dimes on ceedee lamb in a 37 20 romp over washington and reminding the football world of his elite talents yes i called him elite and i m not exaggerating matthew stafford returned to form after looking rusty in his 2026 debut torching the giants by leaning heavily on davante adams jared goff was excellent in the second half of detroit s week 2 loss a reality that will be lost on most who only check final scores for the lions sake hopefully his efforts will produce more wins going forward next gen stats insight via nfl pro goff has the most games with 2 passing touchdowns and zero interceptions in the nfl since the start of 2024 18 2023 25 2022 31 and 2021 35 the year he was traded to the lions tier 2 the bengals were a bit uneven offensively against houston s top tier defense but they won with big plays made possible by joe burrow s arm talent decision making and willingness to let it rip while under duress he and the bengals haven t been consistently explosive through two weeks but burrow deserves credit for going into houston and leading cincinnati to a 14 point win next gen stats insight via nfl pro burrow completed all three of his deep passes 20 air yards to ja marr chase for 73 yards and two tds in week 2 against the texans it was jarring to watch baltimore s offense lose its juice once derrick henry disappeared from the game plan in week 2 and it didn t reflect well on lamar jackson yes he didn t have wr1 zay flowers available but jackson s inability to overcome a surprising change in defensive strategy new orleans decreased its blitz rate in the second half and improved and his game sealing interception dealt a blow to his sparkling reputation for at least one week next gen stats insight via nfl pro jackson used play action on 34 2 of dropbacks against the saints completing 6 of his 10 play action attempts for 101 yards bryce young stacked another excellent showing on top of his season debut making throws that wowed viewers and buoyed his standing in the qb index the confidence and conviction represents a significant step forward for a quarterback who needs a career year ahead of contract talks trevor lawrence was incredibly sharp early in denver fitting passes into tight windows and pushing the jaguars offense forward his dropoff in the second half was disappointing though and contributed directly to jacksonville s defeat tier 3 tyler shough has an obvious clutch gene and unchecked bravery that has already propelled two second half comebacks this season and powered the saints to one of the biggest upsets of week 2 it sure helps that chris olave is blossoming a product of a symbiotic relationship between quarterback and receiver next gen stats insight via nfl pro shough completed 10 of his 13 attempts against the blitz for 113 yards a career high mark while also going 17 for 21 for 139 yards and a touchdown when facing four or fewer rushers drew lock lit up arizona in his first start in place of the injured sam darnold throwing without fear and reaping the benefits he steadied the seahawks offense in a situation that could have taken a downward turn with a lesser quarterback next gen stats insight via nfl pro lock completed 7 of 11 downfield pass attempts 10 air yards for 175 yards in week 2 against the cardinals the second most of his career along with two touchdowns jalen hurts tossed a couple of interceptions against the titans but he also pushed the eagles to victory with his late game heroics with a j brown no longer in the mix in philly hurts rapport with devonta smith is among the most enjoyable developments of the early portion of 2026 c j stroud has played well at times in the first two weeks but he hasn t yet strung together a complete performance next gen stats insight via nfl pro through two weeks stroud leads the league in dropbacks 104 and pass attempts 93 only 10 8 of his pass attempts have been thrown at or behind the line of scrimmage the second lowest rate in the league jayden daniels played really well in the first half of washington s week 2 loss and likely would have kept the game close to the very end had he not suffered a dislocated left elbow on the final play of the second quarter it s a massively disappointing development for both the commanders and fans of electrifying quarterback play brian flores vikings defense got after caleb williams whose fast and loose playing style burned him when he attempted an off balance throw on the run that resulted in an interception williams still had his moments but he couldn t overcome the elements or minnesota s aggression and his hamstring injury was an awful way to end his day we ll all hope williams can return near full strength before long because he s so fun to watch tier 4 jordan love was thrown into the rain at metlife stadium in week 2 and unsurprisingly he struggled he did manage to lead a comeback victory with an offense that lacks any semblance of a running game though he ll need to improve before long or else he ll continue to hover around the dalton line daniel jones did his best to keep the colts in a thrilling sunday night contest and nearly threw them to victory next gen stats insight via nfl pro jones used play action on 51 5 of his dropbacks vs the chiefs his second highest rate in a game in his career and was effective when doing so completing 14 of his 16 attempts for 159 yards and a touchdown his second most yards on play action passes in a game in his career kirk cousins has been tremendously fun to watch especially for fans of grizzled veterans who might be getting their final chance to play meaningful football before father time arrives cousins play against the chargers was heroic at times and he s done a great job of quieting the conversation regarding rookie fernando mendoza s eventual rise to the top job next gen stats insight via nfl pro cousins joined tom brady 2021 2015 and peyton manning 2014 as the only quarterbacks age 38 or older with at least three touchdown passes in each of his team s first two games of a season drake maye played better against the steelers than the 20 3 final score suggested but the patriots have a problem with finishing drives maye still isn t close to the elite quarterback he was in 2025 tier 5 justin herbert isn t the main reason the chargers are 0 2 he s made plenty of excellent throws but he also isn t helping los angeles in key moments when taking unnecessary risks that result in turnovers next gen stats insight via nfl pro herbert has gone 0 for 7 with two ints on tight window throws this season less than one yard of separation while attempting those throws at a 13 0 clip a mark just below the nfl average 14 3 geno smith s solid start carried over into week 2 for a portion of the contest but the weather didn t help his efforts in a disappointing loss bo nix and the broncos still have a problem with starting slowly and nix continues to vacillate between a quarterback who can make incredible throws and commit maddening mistakes next gen stats insight via nfl pro nix completed 16 of 17 passes against four or fewer rushers for 205 yards and a td in week 2 against the jaguars tied for the second highest completion percentage when not facing the blitz by any quarterback since the start of last season min 10 attempts jaxson dart s encouraging start to 2026 was interrupted by a knee injury that wiped out the rest of his season throwing the giants into a depressing and familiar scenario from which they thought they d graduated tier 6 cam ward and the titans were much better offensively in week 2 they gave the eagles a four quarter battle most didn t expect to see ward appears to be gaining confidence in brian daboll s offense and has regained some of his playmaking ability that drove optimism after his rookie season although there s still plenty of room to grow it was nice to see deshaun watson produce competent play on a sunday it wasn t great by any means nor was it pretty but watson keyed a second half comeback that saw the browns outscore the buccaneers 17 3 to finish the game including a 55 yard catch and run touchdown for rookie denzel boston his second in as many weeks and a third down completion to tight end blake whiteheart for the game winning score that s exponentially better than anything i ve written about watson in about two years which is worthy of a bump next gen stats insight via nfl pro watson is the first starting qb to lead a fourth quarter comeback to snap a 6 game personal losing streak since justin fields 2025 jacoby brissett played better against the seahawks than his stat line suggested in the first half by leaning heavily on trey mcbride for two quarters it appeared as if brissett might go toe to toe with drew lock that optimism faded in a lopsided second half in which brissett couldn t overcome the suffocating seattle defense next gen stats insight via nfl pro brissett was under pressure on 41 9 of dropbacks in week 2 against the seahawks completing 4 of 11 passes for 9 yards with an int under pressure and 13 of 17 for 86 yards and a td from a clean pocket we have real reason to be concerned about tampa bay s offense a scheme in which baker mayfield simply appears uncomfortable and uncertain i m not sure there s a quick fix to this issue either a frantic skittish mayfield isn t going to be capable of overcoming an offense that lacks identity rhythm and confidence tier 7 malik willis is trying his best to lead an offense that simply doesn t take care of the details and carries one of the lowest ceilings in the nfl it s not necessarily his fault but it s clear he s not quite the quarterback who can carry an undermanned team to victory at this stage in his career aaron rodgers age was painfully obvious in new england on sunday his offensive line struggled to protect him his receivers didn t help him and he didn t look like he enjoyed his job very much somehow an offense with more freedom to be aggressive has produced worse results and at 42 years old it looks like rodgers isn t capable of overcoming these challenges right now next gen stats insight via nfl pro rodgers finished with 187 passing yards 0 touchdowns and 1 int his fifth straight start with one passing td or fewer tied for the second longest such streak of his career carson wentz s performance was entirely forgettable in a rainy 9 3 victory in chicago we ll see if kyler murray s return can get the offense back on track cooper rush has been the worst quarterback in the nfl through two weeks but thankfully michael penix is returning to the lineup this week we ll see if his style of play fits better than that of rush who wasn t helped much by an underperforming offensive line

news_mentions.headline: J.J. McCarthy, Mac Jones, Jimmy Garoppolo and 4 other QBs who could help teams in need
news_mentions.body_text: the nfl season is only two weeks old and yet six teams have already dealt with injuries to their starting quarterbacks the falcons were already without michael penix because of his recovery from an acl injury when tua tagovailoa went down with a back injury just days before the opener in week 1 the seahawks lost sam darnold to a glute injury and vikings starter kyler murray suffered a concussion week 2 was even worse the commanders lost jayden daniels to another dislocated elbow the same one he dislocated last season the bears watched caleb williams get carted off with a hamstring injury and then placed backup tyler bagent in the concussion protocol and the giants saw jaxson dart go down with a knee injury that is expected to end his season the spate of early injuries to quarterbacks has reinforced the value of experienced and reliable backups the teams that have them have remained competitive seattle and minnesota are both 2 0 with respective backups drew lock and carson wentz filling in but the teams that lack a solid no 2 or any real depth at the position have paid a price just look at atlanta where third stringer cooper rush was benched during a blowout loss to the panthers after throwing his fourth pick of the season he was replaced by jack strand who promptly threw a pick six there 39 s good news in store for a few teams penix will start for the falcons on thursday night and tagovailoa is back to fully participating in practice darnold is expected to return to practice in some capacity this week for the seahawks and murray has been cleared from the concussion protocol in minnesota but that leaves three teams who could be in search of reinforcement case keenum is the only other quarterback on the bears 39 active roster and although he has 66 starts in his 14 year nfl career he hasn 39 t played a regular season snap since december 2023 for washington it remains unclear how much time daniels might miss x rays of daniels 39 elbow were negative for any fractures but coach dan quinn declined to provide any details about the mri results daniels will not start sunday against the seahawks but how long he 39 ll be out thereafter is unknown in the meantime the commanders will turn to marcus mariota just as they have the past two seasons when daniels has dealt with injuries the difference this time around washington doesn 39 t have an experienced third string qb like it had with josh johnson last year the team 39 s current no 3 is seventh round rookie athan kaliakmanis a young player who showed some promise in the preseason but is still quite green the giants are in an even trickier position dart 39 s prognosis is much worse than what was originally expected jameis winston is expected to take over as the starter but he 39 s the only other quarterback on the giants 39 active roster jake haener a fourth round pick by the saints in 2023 is on the practice squad so who might be available to help finding a quality backup quarterback at this point in the season is difficult but there are several veterans and young qbs who could serve as extra insurance if not more for teams in need from potential trade candidates to street free agents and practice squad players here are some players who may be under consideration either now or after the next prominent starter goes down mac jones the sixth year quarterback has seemingly found his groove with san francisco as brock purdy 39 s backup after a standout rookie season with the patriots in which he was named a pro bowl alternate jones cycled through multiple play callers and quickly regressed he was traded to jacksonville in 2024 and started seven games in relief of trevor lawrence but it wasn 39 t until he signed a two year deal with the 49ers in 2025 that he really showed his worth as a reliable backup he went 5 3 as a fill in starter recording a 69 6 completion percentage averaging 7 4 yards per attempt and compiling a 97 4 passer rating all career bests san francisco may want to hold on to him to spell purdy but it could also get a decent return from a desperate team for a player who is set to be a free agent after this season jimmy garoppolo the 12 year veteran and two time super bowl winner reportedly considered retirement in the offseason but ultimately decided to keep his options open in the nfl as a free agent garoppolo 34 nbsp hasn 39 t had any real playing time since the 2024 season when he started the rams 39 regular season finale against the seahawks and he hasn 39 t had any consistent playing time since the start of the 2023 season with the raiders but he does have a 43 21 record as a starter to go with a 67 4 career completion percentage and 97 6 passer rating josh johnson johnson 40 is in his 19th season of professional football and is still going as a member of the bengals 39 practice squad he is the ultimate journeyman playing for a record 14 nfl teams johnson was washington 39 s third string quarterback last season until daniels went down and he became the backup and then the starter late in the season when mariota suffered a quad injury his familiarity with offensive coordinator david blough and washington 39 s other quarterbacks could make him a viable option if the commanders seek outside reinforcement but johnson also has deep ties to giants coach john harbaugh and his brother chargers coach jim johnson had three stints with the ravens when harbaugh was their coach totaling seven games one start and completing 69 8 percent of his passes for 321 passing yards two tds a pick and a 97 1 passer rating will levis levis signed to the jets 39 practice squad tuesday so should the giants be interested in adding him to their active roster he 39 d have a pretty easy move but would they the 2023 second round pick by the titans showed some promise when he took over for ryan tannehill as a rookie but injuries and poor performances derailed his tenure in tennessee he was benched late in the 2024 season when giants quarterbacks coach brian callahan was tennessee 39 s head coach levis missed all of 2025 because of a shoulder injury and was released last month after losing the backup job to mitchell trubisky anthony richardson richardson never developed into the franchise quarterback the colts hoped he 39 d be when they drafted him with the fourth pick in 2023 injuries performance issues and general readiness questions after he tapped out for a play during a narrow loss to the texans in 2024 put him on the outs with the organization he lost his starting job to daniel jones requested a trade and is now in the final year of his rookie contract the colts declined his fifth year option if richardson is viewed as more of a developmental project then a team in need of immediate help may be unlikely to trade for him but never say never j j mccarthy the same context holds for mccarthy the vikings 39 2024 first round pick mccarthy missed the entirety of his rookie season because of a torn meniscus and was sidelined for seven games last season because of injuries mccarthy fell to third string this season after the team signed murray to start and re signed wentz as his backup mccarthy has started only 10 games and has more interceptions 12 than touchdowns 11 but he 39 s well liked in the harbaugh family jim harbaugh once lauded mccarthy as the greatest quarterback in michigan history brandon allen the 10 year veteran has spent more than four seasons with callahan three in cincinnati when callahan was the bengals 39 offensive coordinator another in tennessee when callahan was head coach and this offseason with the giants allen was among the roster cuts late last month this article originally appeared in the athletic

news_mentions.headline: Falcons vs. Packers: Three must-know storylines for Thursday's Week 3 prime-time game
news_mentions.description: Can the Packers put a sloppy start behind them? Will Michael Penix Jr.'s 2026 debut spark the Falcons' offense? In advance of Thursday's game between Atlanta and Green Bay, Dan Parr provides three storylines you need to know.
news_mentions.body_text: thursday night s battle features two teams yearning for a spark to break out of early season doldrums the packers are playing at home for the first time in 2026 after narrowly avoiding an 0 2 start with a comeback win over the jets in overtime meanwhile the 0 2 falcons are still searching for some positive vibes after being trounced in their home opener by the panthers 34 3 green bay has a chance to make history on thursday with a win the packers will break the nfl record for consecutive victories in home openers currently tied at 13 with the 1976 1988 miami dolphins the falcons have dropped four straight at lambeau field with their last win in titletown coming back when the team s current president of football matt ryan was a rookie quarterback 2008 yes we re still early in the season but as far as week 3 games go the stakes couldn t be much higher for either club three must know storylines 1 can the packers clean it up it s been an uncharacteristically sloppy start for a team with postseason aspirations after making the playoffs in six of the past seven seasons matt lafleur s crew leads the league in penalties and penalty yards it ranks last in rushing yards also jordan love has the lowest completion rate of any quarterback with at least 30 pass attempts 52 1 the only qb over the last 10 seasons with a lower rate in his first two games of a season min 70 attempts was trevor lawrence in the first two games of his career 50 2021 per nfl research yikes obviously the packers have been playing shorthanded without edge terror micah parsons pup list and bell cow back josh jacobs commissioner s exempt list but that doesn t excuse the penalty issues green bay s not getting any better news on the injury front either after losing starting right tackle zach bako bewele torn patellar tendon for the season and wideout jayden reed to a back ailment in the win over the jets maybe the packers are catching the right opponent at the right time the falcons have their own health woes with cb1 a j terrell groin joining an ever growing list of starting defensive players on the sideline there s no way to fix everything with a short week to prepare but playing a cleaner game with love completing 60 plus percent of his throws would be a sign of progress for green bay 2 is michael penix the hero the falcons need penix is set to make his 2026 debut on thursday marking his first game back since tearing his left acl last november it s a very welcome development for a team that averaged a league low eight points and failed to reach the red zone with journeyman cooper rush starting the first two contests penix was cleared for full participation in practice about a month ago so he s had time to gear up for his return to game action it s a huge season for the eighth overall pick of the 2024 nfl draft with atlanta s new brass facing a decision on whether to exercise the fifth year option in his rookie deal next spring he compiled a record of just 4 8 as a starter in his first two seasons completing less than 60 percent of his passes and throwing for fewer than 200 yards per game thursday will give penix a chance to begin rewriting the narrative around his career and the packers are only one game removed from giving up 39 points to a vikings offense that no one is confusing for a juggernaut penix might want to avoid falling into his habit of holding on to the ball for too long though going against the team with the third highest pressure rate in the league 45 6 atlanta certainly has stockpiled an enviable collection of weapons at the skill positions with rb bijan robinson wr drake london and te kyle pitts all capable of performing at an all pro level which leads me to my next point 3 will the falcons utilize their pass catchers atlanta s wide receivers and tight ends have combined for 17 catches 173 receiving yards and zero touchdowns in 2026 all the fewest among the league s wr te units through week 2 the aforementioned pitts has only one catch for 15 yards and he s been targeted just four times that s a problem atlanta offensive coordinator tommy rees acknowledged this week telling reporters he has to do a better job of showcasing pitts who signed a contract extension this offseason that made him one of the highest paid tight ends in the league perhaps the quarterback change will help in that regard but pitts has just two touchdown catches in the 12 games penix has started penix has the arm strength to give the offense the downfield passing game it lacked in the first couple weeks now it s up to the coaching staff to exploit a packers defense that ranks 28th in red zone td percentage allowed 85 7

news_mentions.headline: Falcons name Michael Penix Jr. starting quarterback for Week 3 game vs. Packers
news_mentions.description: Michael Penix Jr. will start at quarterback for the Atlanta Falcons in their Week 3 game against the Green Bay Packers, the team announced.
news_mentions.body_text: after 10 long months michael penix is ready for live nfl action penix will start at quarterback for the atlanta falcons in their week 3 game against the green bay packers on thursday night the team announced on monday penix will be making his first start since suffering a season ending knee injury last november he was officially a full participant in monday s estimated practice report cooper rush started atlanta s first two games of the 2026 season both losses in place of the sidelined penix and tua tagovailoa who has been dealing with an oblique injury falcons coach kevin stefanski said earlier monday that he had no update on who his week 3 starter would be but had an idea where atlanta was going in the end the falcons are going back to their 2024 first round pick penix s road back to the field lasted a little longer than expected after tearing knee ligaments in november and undergoing surgery penix was not cleared to fully participate in practice until aug 22 tagovailoa who was signed in the offseason for the veteran minimum was named the week 1 starter over the still ramping penix but was sidelined due to an oblique injury suffered during practice that week in came rush who through two weeks has struggled to put it mildly the 32 year old journeyman completed 56 4 of his passes for 229 yards and a league high four interceptions in atlanta s first two games which it lost by a combined score of 54 16 rush was benched in the second half of sunday s blowout loss to carolina in favor of undrafted rookie jack strand who fared no better in penix atlanta hopes to have its first glimpse of a legitimate starting qb leading stefanski s offense in 2026 before suffering his season ending injury the southpaw was having a solid campaign in his first full year as starter completing 60 1 of his passes for 1 982 yards nine touchdowns and three picks he finished the year with a league best 1 1 int percentage the falcons could surely use penix s sturdy production to get off the mat on a short week at 0 2 atlanta will be traveling to face the packers in their home opener at a hostile lambeau field atlanta is no stranger to a left handed quarterback stunning the green bay faithful in prime time see mike vick in the 2002 wild card round we ll see if penix can deliver a similar performance on thursday night football

news_mentions.headline: NFL Week 2 Sunday aftermath: Surprising Raiders, soaring Chiefs and sinking Chargers in spotlight
news_mentions.description: How surprising is the Raiders' 2-0 start? Are Patrick Mahomes and the Chiefs truly BACK? Can anyone handle Brian Flores' blitz-happy defense? NFL.com senior news writer Kevin Patra digs into the top storylines coming out of Week 2 of the 2026 NFL season.
news_mentions.body_text: following the scoring splurge in week 1 defenses struck back on sunday the 13 afternoon games on sunday averaged 36 8 points boosted by the two prime time contests the league wide average of 40 9 points per tilt in week 2 is down significantly from week 1 s mark of 49 4 ppg with monday night football remaining five defenses held their opponents without a touchdown on sunday carolina chicago cincinnati minnesota and new england it s notable that two of those teams the bears and panthers were involved in a 96 point week 1 bout the week to week flip underscores that clubs are still figuring themselves out early in the 2026 campaign two high profile quarterback injuries jayden daniels dislocated left elbow and caleb williams hamstring will hover over the early portion of the week as we wait to better understand the extent of those players potential absences let s look at the rest of the aftermath of sunday s showdowns including chiefs prove they re back with ot victory vikings d dominates in gritty win at chicago cowboys get back on track as dak passes romo concern brewing for these four offenses one defender who stuffed the stat sheet in week 2 but first a look at some unexpected developments in the young season raiders lead surprising 2 0 teams if we were ranking the most stunning teams to begin this season at 2 0 we d start with the las vegas raiders then there would be a wide football field long gap before the next squad klint kubiak and co took care of business in the opener against a miami team they were supposed to beat they were expected to be a doormat in l a in week 2 nope instead the raiders sent the chargers spiraling with a 26 14 win outplaying their opponents in all three facets that isn t something we ve been able to say about the silver and black in a long long time it s not just that vegas won its first two games it s that the raiders are winning by being the more professional team in years past the raiders have bungled themselves into the turf they were the ones turning the ball over in key spots making mental mistakes and taking brutal drive killing penalties sunday they were the even keeled squad letting the chargers dunk on themselves vegas capitalized at every turn kirk cousins is far from perfect but the 38 year old can still sling it on throws of 10 plus air yards against the bolts cousins was 8 of 12 for 181 yards three touchdowns and one interception per nfl research the 40 yard touchdown pass to tre tucker was just the third completed pass of 40 plus air yards by a raiders qb over the past three seasons kubiak has modernized the offense while rob leonard s defense has swarmed forcing five turnovers over two games the raiders had 16 takeaways all of last year soberly i anticipate the positive vibes from the raiders first 2 0 start since 2021 to be curtailed particularly as the schedule picks up in october however the building blocks of the future are more visible than at any time in recent memory and that s without the no 1 overall pick fernando mendoza at the helm yet the bengals would probably rank as the next most surprising 2 0 squad not because of the record but because of how they ve won their games on the back of the defense as joe burrow got battered and the offense scuffled for much of sunday s contest in houston the defense kept giving c j stroud and the texans fits the run defense turnaround led by dexter lawrence and jonathan allen has completely flipped how the bengals can play a year ago they were getting gashed as the young linebackers struggled through two weeks with the big boys creating havoc and taking up blockers demetrius knight and barrett carter have played more fluidly sure the young lbs still have some coverage issues but their performance has improved significantly on sunday the bengals did not allow a single touchdown their first game allowing zero tds since a 27 12 road win over the jets back in week 3 of 2022 per nfl research of course there was still the joe burrow ja 39 marr chase magic to put cincy over the top but this was a game the bengals lose with last year s defense while we re here this is how i d rank the eight 2 0 teams with the giants looking to join the list by beating the rams on monday night starting with the most impressive through two weeks buffalo bills san francisco 49ers seattle seahawks kansas city chiefs minnesota vikings cincinnati bengals las vegas raiders philadelphia eagles chiefs mahomes prove they are back trailing the colts in the third quarter and facing a third and 11 patrick mahomes uncorked a 45 yard bomb to tyquan thornton to put the chiefs on the doorstep of a go ahead touchdown the heave underscored that a mahomes is fully back and b the chiefs offense can finally return to being a field stretching menace k c turned back the clock on sunday night with travis kelce looking spry and gobbling up 101 yards and mahomes dropping bombs in the ot win the qb threw for 382 passing yards and three tds while playing near flawless football the presence of kenneth walker has completely unlocked the chiefs offense the rb wasn t as dynamic on sunday night as he was in week 1 yet he still bulldozed his way for 117 yards on 24 carries the threat of walker however is a massive boon to mahomes it opens up the play action in a way the two time mvp hasn t had in the past against indy he recorded a career high 14 completions on play action passes per next gen stats across 17 play action attempts he totaled 137 yards and two touchdowns also after failing to complete a downfield pass in week 1 mahomes finished with six completions on nine downfield attempts 10 air yards for 154 yards after years of living in an offensive box and having to manufacture scores the hard way while leaning on the defense the chiefs attack finally looks like it inhaled fresh oxygen vikings dominant d here to stay boy the vikings can coach the early front runners for coach of the year and assistant coach of the year should both reside in minnesota kevin o connell has made the offense work without his starting quarterback and one of his top running backs starting in place of kyler murray carson wentz struggled in the rain soaked soldier field conditions but unlike in previous years wentz avoided the catastrophic turnover that might have sunk his team the far more impressive unit however belongs to brian flores the vikings defense has been the biggest game changer in a young season the ferocious d flipped the script on green bay in week 1 then smothered a bears team that had just put up 59 points keeping ben johnson s offense out of the end zone for 60 minutes in a 9 3 win flores blitzed caleb williams on 27 of his 33 dropbacks 81 8 before he exited the game in the fourth quarter that blitz rate would have ranked as the third highest mark in a game by a defense since at least 2018 per ngs flores ability to create havoc without confusing his own players or giving up a trove of big plays on the back end is impressive other teams could try it and get repeatedly burned for flores it s a style it s doubly remarkable given the questions minnesota entered the season with on the back end isaiah rodgers has been studly so far and the return of veteran safety harrison smith has been a godsend dallas turner has come on strong in year 3 the former first round pick generated 10 pressures including two sacks on 36 pass rushes against the bears marking his second straight week with double digit pressures per ngs five of the pressures on sunday were unblocked a credit to flores discombobulating the offense as minnesota s offense continues to figure things out flores defense has the muscle and guts to keep the vikes on the winning track boys back on track after dak s record day after the prime time week 1 dud in new york dallas showed its high octane potential in an easy home win over the commanders with dak prescott tossing four touchdown strikes to break tony romo s all time franchise record of 248 passing tds it s quite impressive for a former fourth rounder to put himself in a spot not only to break records but to sprint past them sometimes it s great being naive and i was a little naive just growing up thinking that i could do this and i could do that but yet i think it put such insurmountable belief in my head that i can accomplish whatever i want to accomplish prescott said after the game and any thought that i said or anything that i wanted to do and i mentioned it and i said it out loud i had a mom and i had brothers who poured gas on those thoughts who told me i could and as i said you can call it arrogance you can call it confidence belief whatever you need to i wouldn t be here if i didn t have those thoughts if i didn t believe in myself like that and i just encourage the next little kid out there who comes from the trailer park in louisiana or wherever he may come from and doesn t know if he can do it or have the resources or have the family that you re right believe in what you want to believe in and find the people that support that and you can do it the cowboys continue to have issues with their revamped defense under christian parker the injuries aren t helping but dallas had far too many breakdowns against washington especially early some of the issues are of the mental variety and can be cleaned up sunday was reminiscent of 2025 when the cowboys needed big offensive performances to earn ws fortunately for brian schottenheimer when dak spins it like he did against the commanders few defenses can keep him quiet the hope is that eventually the defense catches up are these four offenses in trouble week 2 sunday spotlight

news_mentions.headline: NFC South training camp 2026 preview: Top storylines for Buccaneers, Falcons, Panthers, Saints
news_mentions.description: As we hurtle toward the 2026 NFL season, Nick Shook breaks down the top NFC South training camp storylines to monitor for the Atlanta Falcons, Carolina Panthers, New Orleans Saints and Tampa Bay Buccaneers.
news_mentions.body_text: with 2026 training camps just around the corner it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams nick shook has the lowdown on the key position battles and top storylines to monitor for the atlanta falcons carolina panthers new orleans saints and tampa bay buccaneers catch up on each nfc south team s offseason developments and 2026 outlook below atlanta falcons carolina panthers new orleans saints tampa bay buccaneers three key storylines 1 stefanski era begins despite a strong finish to the 2025 season the falcons dismissed raheem morris in january and replaced him with another recently fired head man in kevin stefanski shifting the organizational focus from a defensive minded coach to one with extensive experience on the other side of the ball amid the coaching change stefanski wisely chose to retain defensive coordinator jeff ulbrich attempting to maintain a sense of continuity for a unit that was the team s strength last year now the responsibility of pushing the falcons out of the 500 range falls on the shoulders of stefanski a coach with a point to prove after being unceremoniously dumped by the browns he s had success two playoff appearances a postseason win and two coach of the year awards but nothing would be sweeter to stefanski than immediately leading atlanta to the playoffs in his first season at the helm he ll need to produce results fairly quickly too given the falcons expectation of competing after consecutive 8 9 finishes 2 all eyes on the quarterbacks much of stefanski s first year success will depend on the quarterback situation tua tagovailoa hopped on board after he was cut by the dolphins bringing experience to a room that could use it while also providing the falcons with a second left handed quarterback tagovailoa might need to handle the starting duties early in the season too depending on how quickly michael penix can return from the season ending knee injury suffered in 2025 that dynamic could create its own intrigue or perhaps controversy if tagovailoa excels the fit makes sense too stefanski s wide zone rushing attack has traditionally paired with a timing based passing game the scheme that best matches tagovailoa s strengths with two options under center an optimist will say the falcons are in an advantageous position others will note two options usually means no answer at quarterback that is unless penix returns and gets back on track atlanta s former top 10 pick still needs to prove he s worth that draft status and year 3 is typically the pivotal season his progress or lack thereof will heavily influence the trajectory of this team in 2026 3 ulbrich s new look defense atlanta s defense has its work cut out the 2025 falcons improved to 15th in yards allowed per game and 19th in scoring d while finishing second in sacks numbers that suggest there s reason to feel encouraged entering 2026 plenty of departures have followed though leading tackler kaden elliss left for new orleans veteran arnold ebiketie departed for philadelphia david onyemata signed with the jets and dee alford joined the bills leading sack artist and 2025 first round pick james pearce returns but his status remains uncertain after he was arrested and subsequently entered a pretrial intervention program to resolve three felony charges during the offseason the nfl has yet to determine pearce s fate in 2026 but if he misses significant time the combined absences could be enough to sink the unit atlanta responded by adding linebacker christian harris and defensive tackle maason smith as projected starters and also signed da 39 shawn hand and samson ebukam as key rotational players preventing ulbrich from returning to an empty cupboard still the challenge exists fortunately atlanta s very strong in the secondary with the safety duo of jessie bates and xavier watts flanked by stout cover man a j terrell and in april the franchise spent a second round pick on a j s brother avieon terrell giving the defensive backfield another versatile piece if nickelback billy bowman can bounce back from an achilles tear that abruptly ended his promising rookie campaign last november the falcons are quite well equipped to handle opposing aerial attacks still following an offseason with notable roster churn the defense will need to jell quickly in order for atlanta to start off on the right foot back to top three key storylines 1 crunch time for young three seasons into his nfl career bryce young hasn t quite produced enough hard evidence to prove he s a franchise quarterback carolina s leadership will suggest otherwise publicly in late april general manager dan morgan said we really feel like the arrow is up with bryce but that sentiment will change quickly if young regresses in year 4 in 2025 he showed signs of blossoming but wasn t consistent in 2026 he needs to become more reliable on a weekly basis an outcome that should be more likely after another offseason spent under coach dave canales if this is young s breakout season the panthers will happily start discussing a long term extension with the former no 1 overall pick but even if they don t say it publicly they still need to be convinced young is headed in such a direction otherwise the fifth year of his deal could spell the beginning of a transition 2 upgrades in key defensive spots the panthers defense received some much needed offseason love it s only right that a former linebacker morgan spent much of his team s resources upgrading that side of the ball after fielding a middling unit in 2025 carolina should be better in the front seven thanks to the additions of edge rusher jaelan phillips signed for a four year 120 million deal linebacker devin lloyd three years 45 million and defensive tackle lee hunter a second round pick who has the potential to become an ideal run stuffing complement to derrick brown it s not a full scale overhaul because carolina didn t need one rather it was a measured reinforcement of a unit that will aim to improve especially in the pass rushing department if young can take a step or two forward and the panthers can evolve into a stronger more balanced team they ll be well positioned to defend their nfc south crown 3 backfield depth backfield questions linger in charlotte where the panthers benefited from a one year deal with rico dowdle in 2025 then watched him walk to pittsburgh in free agency their current running back situation is once again headlined by chuba hubbard who has eclipsed 1 000 yards once in five nfl seasons while averaging 4 1 yards per carry much of this position group depends on whether 2024 second rounder jonathon brooks who has played three games in his first two seasons due to two acl tears can prove he s healthy enough to contribute carolina attempted to build in some insurance by signing veteran aj dillon but his own injury history and minimal usage in philadelphia in 2025 make for an uncertain outlook trevor etienne also returns for his second season after spending most of his rookie snaps on special teams in total the picture appears unsure if not incomplete that can change if brooks contributes but that s a big question mark for a team expecting to contend for a division title back to top three key storylines 1 can shough build on promising finish tyler shough s late season rise inspired an offseason of optimism in the big easy where the saints larger vision became at least partially visible by the end of the 2025 campaign as new orleans closed the year with four wins in its final five games shough emerged as a promising quarterback with the potential to become a franchise signal caller under coach kellen moore perhaps quicker than most anyone expected now with a full offseason as qb1 under his belt shough enters year 2 with heightened expectations at 26 he s already older than the average sophomore starter and is paired with a former quarterback in moore who has demonstrated his ability to guide offenses toward fruitful futures both in dallas and philadelphia now moore is equipped with a quarterback he can mold a passer who appears wiser and more capable than the average second year starter thanks in part to his extensive collegiate experience there s legitimate reason to think the saints have already answered the most challenging question that comes with a rebuild now it s about proving those optimists right by continuing to build on the progress shough made as a rookie 2 new offensive weapons moore has some new toys in his offense upon the start of free agency new orleans quickly scooped up running back travis etienne giving the saints a much needed successor to alvin kamara with a similar three down skill set kamara is still on the roster too providing new orleans with some depth in a room that also includes kendre miller and devin neal the receiver position welcomed a prestigious addition too when the saints followed their hearts and selected arizona state star jordyn tyson at no 8 overall adding to an intriguing receiver room that includes chris olave and devaughn vele as has long been the case in new orleans health will be paramount for this club tyson and olave have a history of missing time due to injury and kamara played in a career low 11 games last season beyond olave tyson and vele the saints lack reliable depth at wr two more rookies bryce lance and barion brown are slated to compete for spots among a group that also includes trey palmer kevin austin and ja 39 lynn polk if they can keep their best healthy the saints could surprise some folks but as we ve learned in recent years that s far from guaranteed 3 jordan s last dance cam jordan is back for one final season after an offseason mostly spent unsigned the saints legend ultimately re upped on a one year deal in june signing up for one last run with the team he s helped define since entering the league as a first round pick back in 2011 with that comes a message to the rest of this ascending squad there s no time to waste jordan and chase young comprised a potent edge rushing duo in 2025 with each hitting double digit sacks with playmakers at all three levels the saints defense is ready to match its ninth place finish from 2025 it ll have a little extra to play for in 2026 too back to top three key storylines 1 mayfield entering pivotal season baker mayfield has enjoyed a career renaissance in florida over the last three seasons earning a three year 100 million deal with the team after a strong 2023 campaign and largely living up to the standards that come with such a contract when viewed from a league wide perspective baker deserves his spot and shouldn t worry about his future in tampa but those who have followed this team closely also understand that mayfield is a streaky player he s electrifying when at his best and can propel the buccaneers toward great success but he also struggles to get out of his own way at times in 2025 mayfield started white hot leading tampa bay to a 6 2 start and pushing the team into the national conversation as a possible super bowl contender then injuries struck sending mayfield into a stretch of struggles that coincided with roster losses elsewhere and resulted in a pile of defeats and a postseason spent at home for the first time since 2022 he finished with fewer than 4 000 passing yards instead of watching his offensive coordinator land a head coaching job elsewhere thanks in part to his successes as dave canales and liam coen had done before his play caller was fired now mayfield enters a contract year with a hard negotiating deadline the start of training camp without his favorite target mike evans who left for san francisco and with fresh questions to answer should things go well mayfield will remain the bucs franchise quarterback for the foreseeable future but if he encounters more struggles it could cost him millions and inspire changes beyond his control that drastically change the landscape in tampa 2 bowles seat is warm near the end of a frustrating somewhat inexplicable collapse in 2025 plenty of folks expected the buccaneers to move on from todd bowles and start fresh with a new coach that didn t happen of course and bowles is back to justify the organization s support in 2026 if the bucs struggle like they did last season with bowles defense finishing 20th in points allowed he ll likely be out of a job and tampa bay will be facing a potentially significant shift in identity for the first time since tom brady arrived in 2020 some thought it s precisely what the buccaneers needed after 2025 and pointed toward evans departure as proof that things weren t right at one buc place the team will have to embark on the new campaign without two franchise legends in evans and linebacker lavonte david who retired after 14 seasons another concerning sign about tampa s trajectory it will be up to bowles to prove the concerns are overblown 3 does tampa have enough on defense to win despite being led by a defensive minded head coach bowles buccaneers became an offense first team over the last few seasons as mayfield powered an explosive attack bowles units proved average at best finishing 23rd 18th and 19th in total yards allowed over the last three seasons the bucs haven t landed inside the top 10 since 2022 bowles first season as head coach entering 2026 the bucs seem to have an assortment of pieces that could form an improved defense the team wisely spent its first round pick on miami edge rusher rueben bain supplying bowles with a legitimate threat at the edge position opposite yaya diaby for the first time since the final few years of shaq barrett s career which ended with a one game campaign in 2024 tampa bay s secondary should benefit from another year of development for benjamin morrison jacob parrish and tykee smith but as of now it remains a unit carried by antoine winfield bit player in the offense thus far he has one catch for 15 yards headed into thursday night 39 s game against the green bay packers fifty seven tight ends already have more receptions 34 i know the production hasn 39 t been there for him 34 head coach kevin stefanski said 34 but that 39 s not indicative of what we have planned for kyle 34 stefanski has called himself an 34 aficionado 34 of the tight end position but it would be fair to question that fondness at this point 34 we do love tight ends and kyle does fit that mold 34 rees said 34 getting him going is something that is important to us kyle has done nothing but work his tail off and be in the right spots i have to do a better job of making sure his talent is coming to the forefront we take a lot of ownership of that as a staff 34 pitts has only played half of the falcons 39 offensive snaps this year but that usage rate is misleading stefanski said because atlanta pulled its starters early in week 2 the packers might not be the best team against which to get pitts going they are 10th in the league in passing epa allowed on throws to tight ends minus 0 10 which is three times better than their passing epa against wide receivers and running backs according to trumedia 34 it 39 s a long season it would be selfish to get upset 34 pitts said this week 34 obviously i want to do as much as i can to contribute to this offense but it 39 s a long season and we 39 ll get it on track 34 here are a few more lingering questions heading into thursday 39 s game at lambeau field can c j henderson step up with cornerback a j terrell on the injured reserve list and out at least four games c j henderson has a chance that he 39 s been waiting for for a while even if it didn 39 t come the way he 39 d hoped 34 i just want to capitalize on it 34 henderson said 34 i haven 39 t played much ball the last few years so i want to capitalize and let people know i belong in this league 34 henderson and terrell were both first round draft picks in 2020 with henderson going ninth to the jacksonville jaguars and terrell being picked seven spots later by the falcons while terrell has gone on to start 95 games for atlanta henderson has bounced from the jaguars to the carolina panthers and briefly the houston texans and the pittsburgh steelers before landing with the falcons he hasn 39 t been a regular starter since 2023 in carolina but he believes he still has that ability he said this week falcons defensive coordinator jeff ulbrich agreed 34 it is rare in this league to have a backup corner like that 34 ulbrich said 34 a j in my opinion is the best boundary cornerback in the nfl whenever he has to step out normally that would be like 39 my goodness i gotta protect that backup i gotta get the safety over the top i got to do whatever they 39 re gonna go after him 39 i don 39 t feel any angst when c j goes in the game he goes out and every time he 39 s called upon he steps up and answers the bell 34 henderson has 34 career starts including two last year in atlanta there 39 s also a chance nickel corner avieon terrell could play more outside snaps with his older brother out of the lineup stefanski year head coach is 5 0 in thursday night games in his career 34 it definitely helps that it 39 s a short week 34 falcons safety xavier watts said 34 you have to shift your mind you can 39 t linger on last week at all there 39 s no panic whatsoever there is still a lot of time to go 34 is tua tagovailoa the backup this week michael penix might not be the only quarterback back in action this week tagovailoa returned to practice tuesday for the first time since injuring an oblique muscle three days before he was scheduled to start for atlanta in week 1 34 he 39 s trending in the right direction 34 to serve as penix 39 s backup against the packers stefanski said wednesday 34 he 39 s been an awesome teammate 34 stefanski said 34 he 39 s working very very hard to get himself back ultra supportive he 39 s a great guy to have around the building 34 can nick folk regain his form the falcons are not worried about kicker nick folk yet special teams coordinator craig aukerman said against carolina folk missed his third field goal attempt of the season that 39 s the same number of kicks he missed total in the three seasons before signing with atlanta in the offseason 34 our biggest thing is to focus in on his technique continue to hone that in 34 aukerman said 34 this guy has done it a long time in the nfl and he 39 s been consistent the last couple of years we have to get him back in rhythm 34 no team in the league has lost more points to missed kicks than the falcons in the last five seasons 101 according to trumedia folk has missed from 54 53 and 45 yards this season can the defense bounce back ulbrich attributed atlanta 39 s defensive struggles against the panthers to players blowing assignments because they were trying to make big plays as the falcons offense struggled carolina averaged 5 7 yards per play in week 2 34 there were some examples of some veteran guys that we trust implicitly making some very uncharacteristic mistakes we have to play better that is not even close to our standard 34 ulbrich said 34 it comes from the best of places but it 39 s a learning experience when we are struggling as a team like that there is the sense that players have to do more than their job and it led to some breakdowns some failures some explosive plays 34 the packers are 13th in the league in yards per play 5 3 through two weeks but 30th in offensive epa minus 19 08 extra points 8226 the packers have allowed the fourth highest quarterback pressure percentage 43 5 in the league this season while the falcons have the third best pressure rate 43 4 through two weeks 8226 under first year defensive coordinator jonathan gannon the packers have shown a lot of variance in their game plans leaving atlanta expecting to face defensive looks it has not specifically prepared for 34 it looks like two different groups out there in the first two weeks 34 rees said 8226 green bay 39 s skyy moore leads the league in punt return average 18 2 8226 the falcons do plan to try to mess with packers rookie kicker trey smack 34 i am sure our players will say hello to him at some point in the game 34 aukerman said 8226 the falcons are 23rd in the league in rushing success rate 33 3 percent 34 with our offensive production period it 39 s just not good enough 34 stefanski said 34 i am very very confident in the group we have to put a plan together and be successful in the run game 34 this article originally appeared in the athletic

material_news_signals.headline: Falcons name Michael Penix Jr. starting quarterback for Week 3 game vs. Packers
material_news_signals.description: Michael Penix Jr. will start at quarterback for the Atlanta Falcons in their Week 3 game against the Green Bay Packers, the team announced.
material_news_signals.body_text: after 10 long months michael penix is ready for live nfl action penix will start at quarterback for the atlanta falcons in their week 3 game against the green bay packers on thursday night the team announced on monday penix will be making his first start since suffering a season ending knee injury last november he was officially a full participant in monday s estimated practice report cooper rush started atlanta s first two games of the 2026 season both losses in place of the sidelined penix and tua tagovailoa who has been dealing with an oblique injury falcons coach kevin stefanski said earlier monday that he had no update on who his week 3 starter would be but had an idea where atlanta was going in the end the falcons are going back to their 2024 first round pick penix s road back to the field lasted a little longer than expected after tearing knee ligaments in november and undergoing surgery penix was not cleared to fully participate in practice until aug 22 tagovailoa who was signed in the offseason for the veteran minimum was named the week 1 starter over the still ramping penix but was sidelined due to an oblique injury suffered during practice that week in came rush who through two weeks has struggled to put it mildly the 32 year old journeyman completed 56 4 of his passes for 229 yards and a league high four interceptions in atlanta s first two games which it lost by a combined score of 54 16 rush was benched in the second half of sunday s blowout loss to carolina in favor of undrafted rookie jack strand who fared no better in penix atlanta hopes to have its first glimpse of a legitimate starting qb leading stefanski s offense in 2026 before suffering his season ending injury the southpaw was having a solid campaign in his first full year as starter completing 60 1 of his passes for 1 982 yards nine touchdowns and three picks he finished the year with a league best 1 1 int percentage the falcons could surely use penix s sturdy production to get off the mat on a short week at 0 2 atlanta will be traveling to face the packers in their home opener at a hostile lambeau field atlanta is no stranger to a left handed quarterback stunning the green bay faithful in prime time see mike vick in the 2002 wild card round we ll see if penix can deliver a similar performance on thursday night football
